4.89.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yamasyārādhanaṃ brūhi śrīvatsa puruṣottama ..
kathaṃ na gamyate kṛṣṇa narakaṃ narakesarin .. 1 ..
4.89.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यमस्याराधनं ब्रूहि श्रीवत्स पुरुषोत्तम ॥
कथं न गम्यते कृष्ण नरकं नरकेसरिन् ॥ 1 ॥
4.89.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell of the propitiation of Yama, O Śrīvatsa, Supreme Person!
How does one not go to hell, O Kṛṣṇa, lion among men?

4.89.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dvāravatyāṃ purā pārtha snāto'haṃ lavaṇāmbhasi ..
dṛṣṭavānmunimāyāṃtaṃ mudgalaṃ nāma pārthiva .. 2 ..
4.89.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
द्वारवत्यां पुरा पार्थ स्नातोऽहं लवणाम्भसि ॥
दृष्टवान्मुनिमायांतं मुद्गलं नाम पार्थिव ॥ 2 ॥
4.89.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, O son of Pṛthā, when I had bathed in the salt water at Dvāravatī,
I saw a sage named Mudgala arriving, O king.

4.89.s:
prajvalaṃtamivādityaṃ tapasā dyotitāntaram ..
taṃ praṇamyārghyasatkāraiḥ papracchāhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 3 ..
4.89.d:
प्रज्वलंतमिवादित्यं तपसा द्योतितान्तरम् ॥
तं प्रणम्यार्घ्यसत्कारैः पप्रच्छाहं युधिष्ठिर ॥ 3 ॥
4.89.m: Blazing like the sun, with his inner self illuminated by asceticism— / bowing to him with honours and offering water, I asked him, Yudhiṣṭhira:

4.89.s:
yamādarśananāmaitadvrataṃ jantubhayāpaham ..
kathayāmāsa sakalaṃ mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ .. 4 ..
4.89.d:
यमादर्शननामैतद्व्रतं जन्तुभयापहम् ॥
कथयामास सकलं मुद्गलो विस्मयान्वितः ॥ 4 ॥
4.89.m: "This votive observance named Yamādarśana removes fear from creatures." / Filled with wonder, Mudgala related it all.

4.89.s:
.. mudgala uvāca .. ..
akasmātkṛṣṇa mūrcchā me patito'smi dharātale ..
paśyāmi daṃḍapuruṣairmaddehātprajvalanniva .. 5 ..
4.89.d:
॥ मुद्गल उवाच ॥ ॥
अकस्मात्कृष्ण मूर्च्छा मे पतितोऽस्मि धरातले ॥
पश्यामि दंडपुरुषैर्मद्देहात्प्रज्वलन्निव ॥ 5 ॥
4.89.m: Mudgala said: / "Suddenly, Kṛṣṇa, swooning seized me, and I fell onto the earth's surface. / I saw, as if blazing, pulled out from my body by staff-bearing men,

4.89.s:
aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo baladākṛṣya roṣitaḥ ..
baddho yamabhaṭairgāḍhaṃ nīyate vedavādibhiḥ .. 6 ..
4.89.d:
अंगुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषो बलदाकृष्य रोषितः ॥
बद्धो यमभटैर्गाढं नीयते वेदवादिभिः ॥ 6 ॥
4.89.m: a person the measure of a thumb, dragged by force and enraged, / tightly bound by Yama’s soldiers who speak the Veda, and being led away.

4.89.s:
kṣaṇātsabhāyāṃ paśyāmi yamaṃ piṃgalalocanam ..
kṛṣṇāvadātaṃ raudrāsyaṃ mṛtyuṃ vyādhiśatānvitam .. 7 ..
4.89.d:
क्षणात्सभायां पश्यामि यमं पिंगललोचनम् ॥
कृष्णावदातं रौद्रास्यं मृत्युं व्याधिशतान्वितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.89.m: In an instant I saw Yama in his assembly, yellow-eyed, / dark and bright, with a dreadful mouth—Death accompanied by hundreds of diseases,

4.89.s:
vātapittamahāśleṣmairmūrtimadbhirupāsitam ..
kāsaśophajvarātaṃkasphoṭikālūtamāribhiḥ .. 8 ..
4.89.d:
वातपित्तमहाश्लेष्मैर्मूर्तिमद्भिरुपासितम् ॥
कासशोफज्वरातंकस्फोटिकालूतमारिभिः ॥ 8 ॥
4.89.m: attended by the embodied great humours: wind, bile, and phlegm; / by cough, swelling, fever, pestilence, pox, spider-poison, and plagues;

4.89.s:
jvaragardabhaśīrṣādibhagaṃdaramalakṣayaiḥ ..
gaṃḍamālākṣirogaiśca mūtrakṛcchrarahovraṇaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.89.d:
ज्वरगर्दभशीर्षादिभगंदरमलक्षयैः ॥
गंडमालाक्षिरोगैश्च मूत्रकृच्छ्ररहोव्रणैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.89.m: by fevers, donkey-head disease and the like, fistula, constipation, consumption, / scrofula, eye diseases, strangury, and sores on secret parts;

4.89.s:
vedanābhiḥ pramehaiśca piṭakairgaṃḍabudbudaiḥ ..
viṣūcikāgalagrāhadaridrābhūtataskaraiḥ .. 4.89.10 ..
4.89.d:
वेदनाभिः प्रमेहैश्च पिटकैर्गंडबुद्बुदैः ॥
विषूचिकागलग्राहदरिद्राभूततस्करैः ॥ 4.89.10 ॥
4.89.m: by afflictions, urinary disorders, boils, tumours, and pustules; / by cholera, throat-seizure, poverty, ghosts, and thieves;

4.89.s:
itthaṃ bahuvidhai raudrairnānārūpabhayaṃkaraiḥ ..
karālaśastrahastaiśca saṃgrāmairnarakaistathā .. 11 ..
4.89.d:
इत्थं बहुविधै रौद्रैर्नानारूपभयंकरैः ॥
करालशस्त्रहस्तैश्च संग्रामैर्नरकैस्तथा ॥ 11 ॥
4.89.m: thus surrounded by terrible forms of many kinds, frightening with diverse shapes, / with terrifying weapons in hand, by battles and by hells;

4.89.s:
rākṣasairdānavairugrairupaviṣṭaiḥ puraḥsthitaiḥ ..
dharmādhikaraṇasthaiśca citraguptādilekhakaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.89.d:
राक्षसैर्दानवैरुग्रैरुपविष्टैः पुरःस्थितैः ॥
धर्माधिकरणस्थैश्च चित्रगुप्तादिलेखकैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.89.m: by fierce rākṣasas and dānavas seated and standing before him, / and by Citragupta and other scribes seated in the court of justice;

4.89.s:
siṃhairvyāghrairvarāhaiśca tarakṣaiścānujaṃtukaiḥ ..
vṛścikairdaṃśa maśakaiḥ śivāsarpaiḥ saḍuṃḍubhaiḥ .. 13 ..
4.89.d:
सिंहैर्व्याघ्रैर्वराहैश्च तरक्षैश्चानुजंतुकैः ॥
वृश्चिकैर्दंश मशकैः शिवासर्पैः सडुंडुभैः ॥ 13 ॥
4.89.m: by lions, tigers, boars, hyenas, and smaller beasts; / by scorpions, biting flies, mosquitoes, jackals, snakes, and water-serpents;

4.89.s:
gṛdhrairulūkairbahubhirmatkuṇairḍākinīgrahaiḥ ..
apasmārasmaronmādavṛddhikārevatīgrahaiḥ .. 14 ..
4.89.d:
गृध्रैरुलूकैर्बहुभिर्मत्कुणैर्डाकिनीग्रहैः ॥
अपस्मारस्मरोन्मादवृद्धिकारेवतीग्रहैः ॥ 14 ॥
4.89.m: by vultures, owls, numerous bedbugs, and the grasping spirits of ḍākinīs; / by epilepsy, lovesickness, madness, growth, and the grasping spirits of Revatī;

4.89.s:
piśācairyakṣakūṣmāṃḍaiḥ pāśakhaḍgadhanurddharaiḥ ..
muktakeśaistrāsakarairbhṛkuṭīkuṭilānanaiḥ .. 15 ..
4.89.d:
पिशाचैर्यक्षकूष्मांडैः पाशखड्गधनुर्द्धरैः ॥
मुक्तकेशैस्त्रासकरैर्भृकुटीकुटिलाननैः ॥ 15 ॥
4.89.m: by piśācas, yakṣas, and kūṣmāṇḍas holding nooses, swords, and bows, / dishevelled-haired, terrifying, with faces crooked with frowns;

4.89.s:
bṛhatkāyairnārakīyaiḥ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ niyāmakaiḥ ..
asipatravanāṃgāraiḥ kṣāragartāṇḍadāyakaiḥ .. 16 ..
4.89.d:
बृहत्कायैर्नारकीयैः पापिष्ठानां नियामकैः ॥
असिपत्रवनांगारैः क्षारगर्ताण्डदायकैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.89.m: by large-bodied hell-beings who discipline the most wicked sinners, / dispensers of the sword-leafed forest, burning coals, caustic pits, and testicle-torture;

4.89.s:
asibhaṃgāmiṣacchedarudhirasrāvakādibhiḥ ..
āsthāne saṃbhṛto bhāti yamo mṛtyūpamopamaḥ .. 27 ..
4.89.d:
असिभंगामिषच्छेदरुधिरस्रावकादिभिः ॥
आस्थाने संभृतो भाति यमो मृत्यूपमोपमः ॥ 27 ॥
4.89.m: by breakers of swords, cutters of flesh, shedders of blood, and the like. / Furnished in his hall, Yama shone forth, comparable to Death himself.

4.89.s:
sa āha kiṃkarānsarvāndharmarājo janārdana ..
kimayaṃ munirānīto yuṣmābhirbhrāṃtanāmabhiḥ .. 18 ..
4.89.d:
स आह किंकरान्सर्वान्धर्मराजो जनार्दन ॥
किमयं मुनिरानीतो युष्माभिर्भ्रांतनामभिः ॥ 18 ॥
4.89.m: That King of Justice said to all his servants, O Janārdana: / 'Why has this sage been brought here by you who have confused his name?

4.89.s:
mudgalo nāma kauḍinye nagare bhīṣmakātmajaḥ..
kṣatriyo'sti sa āneyaḥ kṣīṇāyustyajyatāṃ muniḥ .. 19 ..
4.89.d:
मुद्गलो नाम कौडिन्ये नगरे भीष्मकात्मजः॥
क्षत्रियोऽस्ति स आनेयः क्षीणायुस्त्यज्यतां मुनिः ॥ 19 ॥
4.89.m: There is a kṣatriya named Mudgala, son of Bhīṣmaka, in the city of Kauṇḍinya. / He whose lifespan is exhausted is the one to be brought; release the sage!'

4.89.s:
ityuktāste gatāstasmādāyātāḥ punareva te ..
ūcuryamabhaṭāḥ prahvā dharmarājaṃ savismayāḥ ..4.89.20 ..
4.89.d:
इत्युक्तास्ते गतास्तस्मादायाताः पुनरेव ते ॥
ऊचुर्यमभटाः प्रह्वा धर्मराजं सविस्मयाः ॥4.89.20 ॥
4.89.m: Addressed thus, they departed from there and then returned again. / Bowing low, full of wonder, Yama’s soldiers spoke to the King of Justice:

4.89.s:
asmābhistatra kṣīṇāyurna dehī lakṣito gataiḥ ..
na jānīmo bhānusūno kathaṃcidbhrāṃtamānasāḥ .. 21 ..
4.89.d:
अस्माभिस्तत्र क्षीणायुर्न देही लक्षितो गतैः ॥
न जानीमो भानुसूनो कथंचिद्भ्रांतमानसाः ॥ 21 ॥
4.89.m: 'Having gone there, no embodied being whose lifespan is exhausted was perceived by us. / With our minds somehow bewildered, O son of the Sun, we do not know.'

4.89.s:
.. yamarāja uvāca .. ..
prāyeṇa te na dṛśyaṃte puruṣairyamakiṃkaraiḥ ..
kṛtā trayodaśī yaistu narakārtivināśinī .. 22 ..
4.89.d:
॥ यमराज उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रायेण ते न दृश्यंते पुरुषैर्यमकिंकरैः ॥
कृता त्रयोदशी यैस्तु नरकार्तिविनाशिनी ॥ 22 ॥
4.89.m: King Yama said: / 'Generally, they are not seen by the men who are Yama’s servants— / those by whom the thirteenth [tithi], which destroys the suffering of hell, has been observed,

4.89.s:
ujjayinyāṃ prayāge vā bhairave vātha ye mṛtāḥ ..
tilānnagohiraṇyādi dattaṃ yaiśca gavāhnikam .. 23 ..
4.89.d:
उज्जयिन्यां प्रयागे वा भैरवे वाथ ये मृताः ॥
तिलान्नगोहिरण्यादि दत्तं यैश्च गवाह्निकम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.89.m: or those who have died in Ujjayinī, at Prayāga, or at Bhairava, / and by whom sesamum, cooked food, cows, gold and the like have been given as daily food for cows.'

4.89.s:
.. dūta uvāca .. ..
dṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ svāmiñchaṃsa no bhāskarātmaja ..
kiṃ tatra vada kartavyaṃ puruṣaistava tuṣṭidam .. 24 ..
4.89.d:
॥ दूत उवाच ॥ ॥
दृशं तद्व्रतं स्वामिञ्छंस नो भास्करात्मज ॥
किं तत्र वद कर्तव्यं पुरुषैस्तव तुष्टिदम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.89.m: The messenger said: / 'Describe such a votive observance to us, O Lord, son of the Sun. / Tell what must be done there by men to bring you satisfaction.'

4.89.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
pūrvāhne mārgaśīrṣādau varṣamekaṃ nirantaram ..
trayodaśyāṃ saumyadine sūryāṃgārakavarjitaḥ .. 25 ..
4.89.d:
॥ यम उवाच ॥ ॥
पूर्वाह्ने मार्गशीर्षादौ वर्षमेकं निरन्तरम् ॥
त्रयोदश्यां सौम्यदिने सूर्यांगारकवर्जितः ॥ 25 ॥
4.89.m: Yama said: / 'In the morning, beginning in Mārgaśīrṣa, continuously for one year, / on the thirteenth [tithi] on a gentle day, avoiding Sunday and Tuesday,

4.89.s:
mama nāmnā dvijānaṣṭau paṃca caiva samāhvayet ..
vedāṃtagāñjātiśuddhāñchāṃtacittānsuśobhanān .. 26 ..
4.89.d:
मम नाम्ना द्विजानष्टौ पंच चैव समाह्वयेत् ॥
वेदांतगाञ्जातिशुद्धाञ्छांतचित्तान्सुशोभनान् ॥ 26 ॥
4.89.m: in my name one should summon eight and five twice-born, / masters of the Vedānta, pure of birth, peaceful in mind, and very handsome,

4.89.s:
vācakaścāpi tanmadhye sadā bhāskaravallabhān ..
dinasya prathame yāme śucau deśe samāsthitān .. 27 ..
4.89.d:
वाचकश्चापि तन्मध्ये सदा भास्करवल्लभान् ॥
दिनस्य प्रथमे यामे शुचौ देशे समास्थितान् ॥ 27 ॥
4.89.m: and also a reciter among them, who are always dear to the Sun, / settled in a clean place in the first watch of the day.

4.89.s:
aṃtarvāsovṛtānbhaktānsaupadiṣṭadigunmukhān ..
abhyaṃgayecchirodeśāttilatailena marddayet .. 28 ..
4.89.d:
अंतर्वासोवृतान्भक्तान्सौपदिष्टदिगुन्मुखान् ॥
अभ्यंगयेच्छिरोदेशात्तिलतैलेन मर्द्दयेत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.89.m: Devoted, clad in undergarments, facing the prescribed direction, / one should anoint their heads and rub them with sesamum oil.

4.89.s:
snāpayedgandhakāṣāyaiḥ sukhoṣṇāṃbubhireva ca ..
pṛthakpṛthaksnāpayitvā sarvāneva dvijottamān .. 29 ..
4.89.d:
स्नापयेद्गन्धकाषायैः सुखोष्णांबुभिरेव च ॥
पृथक्पृथक्स्नापयित्वा सर्वानेव द्विजोत्तमान् ॥ 29 ॥
4.89.m: One should bathe them with fragrant astringents and with pleasantly warm waters. / Having bathed all the excellent twice-born one by one,

4.89.s:
śucirbhūtvā tathācāṃto vratī bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
svayaṃ saṃbhṛtya śuśruṣāṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā narottama .. 4.89.30 ..
4.89.d:
शुचिर्भूत्वा तथाचांतो व्रती भक्तिपरायणः ॥
स्वयं संभृत्य शुश्रुषां तेषां कृत्वा नरोत्तम ॥ 4.89.30 ॥
4.89.m: having become pure and having sipped water, the observer of the vow, dedicated to devotion, / having personally provided service to them, O best of men,

4.89.s:
prāṅmukhānupaviṣṭāṃśca trayodaśa pṛthakpṛthak ..
bhojayecchālimudgādyaṃ guḍapūpānsukhocitān.. 31 ..
4.89.d:
प्राङ्मुखानुपविष्टांश्च त्रयोदश पृथक्पृथक् ॥
भोजयेच्छालिमुद्गाद्यं गुडपूपान्सुखोचितान्॥ 31 ॥
4.89.m: seated facing east, the thirteen, one by one, / one should feed with śāli rice, mung beans and the like, and pleasant jaggery cakes.

4.89.s:
suvyañjanaṃ supakvānnaṃ bhūyobhūyo nivedayet ..
śucirbhūtvā tathācāṃto hyarcayettilataṃḍulaiḥ ..32..
4.89.d:
सुव्यञ्जनं सुपक्वान्नं भूयोभूयो निवेदयेत् ॥
शुचिर्भूत्वा तथाचांतो ह्यर्चयेत्तिलतंडुलैः ॥32॥
4.89.m: One should repeatedly offer excellent condiments and well-cooked food. / Having become pure and having sipped water, one should worship them with sesamum and unbroken rice.

4.89.s:
prasthamātrairathaikaikaṃ tāmrapātrasamanvitaiḥ ..
sadakṣiṇaiḥ sacchatraiśca jalakumbhaiḥ pavitrakaiḥ ..33..
4.89.d:
प्रस्थमात्रैरथैकैकं ताम्रपात्रसमन्वितैः ॥
सदक्षिणैः सच्छत्रैश्च जलकुम्भैः पवित्रकैः ॥33॥
4.89.m: One by one, with [vessels] measuring a prastha, accompanied by copper vessels, / with fees, with royal parasols, and with pure water-jars,

4.89.s:
carmaprāvaraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaisteṣāṃ dattvā visarjayet ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra arcayettānpṛthaksudhīḥ ..
brāhmaṇānvācakaṃ vāpi paṃktibhedaṃ na kārayet .. 34 ..
4.89.d:
चर्मप्रावरणैः श्रेष्ठैस्तेषां दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र अर्चयेत्तान्पृथक्सुधीः ॥
ब्राह्मणान्वाचकं वापि पंक्तिभेदं न कारयेत् ॥ 34 ॥
4.89.m: and having given them excellent leather cloaks, one should dismiss them. / With this mantra, O King of kings, the wise man should worship them individually, / whether the brāhmaṇas or the reciter, and make no distinction in the line:

4.89.s:
oṃ namaḥ śanaiścaro mṛtyurdaṃḍahasto vināśakaḥ ..
abhāvaḥ pralayaḥ saurirduḥkhaghnaḥ śamanoṃ'takaḥ .. 35 ..
4.89.d:
ओं नमः शनैश्चरो मृत्युर्दंडहस्तो विनाशकः ॥
अभावः प्रलयः सौरिर्दुःखघ्नः शमनोंऽतकः ॥ 35 ॥
4.89.m: 'Om, salutation! Saturn, Death, staff in hand, Destroyer, / Non-existence, Dissolution, son of the Sun, Destroyer of sorrow, Chastiser, Finisher,

4.89.s:
lokapālo hyatikrūro raudro ghorānanaḥ śivaḥ ..
yamaḥ prasannamānasko dadyānme'bhayadakṣiṇām .. (svāhā) .. 36 ..
4.89.d:
लोकपालो ह्यतिक्रूरो रौद्रो घोराननः शिवः ॥
यमः प्रसन्नमानस्को दद्यान्मेऽभयदक्षिणाम् ॥ (स्वाहा) ॥ 36 ॥
4.89.m: World protector, exceedingly cruel, fierce, terrible-faced, auspicious— / may Yama, pleased in mind, grant me the fee of fearlessness. [Svāhā].'

4.89.s:
ityuktvā saṃprayacchecca deyaṃ dattvā vratī punaḥ ..
dvijāṃścānuvrajetṛptāngṛhāṃścārcitacarcitān .. 37 ..
4.89.d:
इत्युक्त्वा संप्रयच्छेच्च देयं दत्त्वा व्रती पुनः ॥
द्विजांश्चानुव्रजेतृप्तान्गृहांश्चार्चितचर्चितान् ॥ 37 ॥
4.89.m: Having spoken thus, the observer of the vow should bestow what is to be given, / and then follow the satisfied twice-born to their houses, repeatedly honoured.

4.89.s:
evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścitsakṛdvratamidaṃ caret ..
sa mṛto'pi naro martyo nāyāti mama maṃdiram.. 38 ..
4.89.d:
एवं यः पुरुषः कश्चित्सकृद्व्रतमिदं चरेत् ॥
स मृतोऽपि नरो मर्त्यो नायाति मम मंदिरम्॥ 38 ॥
4.89.m: Any man who performs this votive observance even once in this way, / even though dead, that mortal man does not come to my dwelling.

4.89.s:
adṛṣṭo mama māyābhirvimānenārkamaṃḍalam ..
sa cāyāti purīṃ viṣṇostataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 39 ..
4.89.d:
अदृष्टो मम मायाभिर्विमानेनार्कमंडलम् ॥
स चायाति पुरीं विष्णोस्ततः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.89.m: Unseen by my illusive powers, he reaches the solar orb by celestial chariot, / and he goes to the city of Viṣṇu, and thence he proceeds to the realm of Śiva.

4.89.s:
kṛtaṃ cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tena mudgalena mamoditam ..
tena nāyātyasau loke mama kṣatriyapuṅgavaḥ .. 4.89.40 ..
4.89.d:
कृतं चीर्णं व्रतं तेन मुद्गलेन ममोदितम् ॥
तेन नायात्यसौ लोके मम क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः ॥ 4.89.40 ॥
4.89.m: That Mudgala has performed the votive observance proclaimed by me; / on that account, that best of kṣatriyas does not come to my world.'—

4.89.s:
iti kālavacaḥ śrutvā te'pi dūtā gatāstu me ..
ahaṃ punaḥ samāpannastūrṇaṃ kālairvisarjitaḥ ..
svaśarīraṃ punaḥ prāpya nīrogaḥ punarutthitaḥ .. 41 ..
4.89.d:
इति कालवचः श्रुत्वा तेऽपि दूता गतास्तु मे ॥
अहं पुनः समापन्नस्तूर्णं कालैर्विसर्जितः ॥
स्वशरीरं पुनः प्राप्य नीरोगः पुनरुत्थितः ॥ 41 ॥
4.89.m: Having heard these words of the God of Time, those messengers of mine departed. / Released quickly by the officers of Time, I returned, / attained my own body again, and stood up once more, free of disease.

4.89.s:
tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ proktametadvṛttaṃ mayā tava ..
ityuktvā mudgalo rājanprayātaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati .. .. 42 ..
4.89.d:
त्वां द्रष्टुमागतः प्रोक्तमेतद्वृत्तं मया तव ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मुद्गलो राजन्प्रयातः स्वगृहं प्रति ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
4.89.m: I have come to see you, and this event has been related by me to you." / Having spoken thus, O king, Mudgala departed for his own home.

4.89.s:
idaṃ kuruṣva kauṃteya tvamapyatra mahītale ..
tato yāsyasyasaṃdigdhaṃ vaṃcayitvā yamaṃ mṛtaḥ .. 43 ..
4.89.d:
इदं कुरुष्व कौंतेय त्वमप्यत्र महीतले ॥
ततो यास्यस्यसंदिग्धं वंचयित्वा यमं मृतः ॥ 43 ॥
4.89.m: "Perform this, O son of Kuntī, you too here on the surface of the earth; / then, having died, you will without doubt go [to heaven], having bypassed Yama.

4.89.s:
evaṃ yenye'pi puruṣāḥ striyo vāpi yudhi ṣṭhira ..
trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ ye cariṣyaṃti bhūtale .. 44 ..
4.89.d:
एवं येन्येऽपि पुरुषाः स्त्रियो वापि युधि ष्ठिर ॥
त्रयोदश्यां त्रयोदश्यां ये चरिष्यंति भूतले ॥ 44 ॥
4.89.m: Likewise, whichever other men or women, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / will practice this on every thirteenth [tithi] on the surface of the earth—"

4.89.s:
ekabhaktena naktena upavāsena vā punaḥ ..
yamadarśanamākhyātaṃ gataṃ sarvavratottamam ..45..
4.89.d:
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन उपवासेन वा पुनः ॥
यमदर्शनमाख्यातं गतं सर्वव्रतोत्तमम् ॥45॥
4.89.m: By taking a single meal, by a nocturnal meal, or by fasting, / this is declared the Vision of Yama, the foremost of all votive observances.

4.89.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktā divyayānaṃ samāśritāḥ ..
yāsyantīndrapuraṃ hṛṣṭā apsarogaṇasaṃvṛtāḥ .. 46 ..
4.89.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता दिव्ययानं समाश्रिताः ॥
यास्यन्तीन्द्रपुरं हृष्टा अप्सरोगणसंवृताः ॥ 46 ॥
4.89.m: Released from all sins, mounted upon a divine carriage, / rejoicing and surrounded by hosts of apsarases, they go to Indra's city,

4.89.s:
dodhūyamānāścamaraiḥ stūyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ ..
gandharvatūryanādena cchatrapaṃktivirājitāḥ .. 47 ..
4.89.d:
दोधूयमानाश्चमरैः स्तूयमानाः सुरासुरैः ॥
गन्धर्वतूर्यनादेन च्छत्रपंक्तिविराजिताः ॥ 47 ॥
4.89.m: fanned with chowries, praised by gods and asuras, / accompanied by the sound of gandharva musical instruments, and adorned with rows of parasols.

4.89.s:
adṛṣṭo ghorarūpāsyairyamadūtairyudhiṣṭhira ..
anardito vyādhigaṇairadṛṣṭo yamakiṅkaraiḥ .. 48 ..
4.89.d:
अदृष्टो घोररूपास्यैर्यमदूतैर्युधिष्ठिर ॥
अनर्दितो व्याधिगणैरदृष्टो यमकिङ्करैः ॥ 48 ॥
4.89.m: Unseen by the messengers of Yama with terrible forms and mouths, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / untormented by hosts of diseases, unseen by Yama's attendants,

4.89.s:
adārito mahāraudrairnānāpraharaṇottamaiḥ..
yamadṛṣṭipathānmuktāḥ sarvasaukhyasamanvitāḥ ..49..
4.89.d:
अदारितो महारौद्रैर्नानाप्रहरणोत्तमैः॥
यमदृष्टिपथान्मुक्ताः सर्वसौख्यसमन्विताः ॥49॥
4.89.m: untorn by very fierce, best of diverse weapons, / freed from the path of Yama's sight, endowed with all happiness,

4.89.s:
sarvasaukhyasamāyuktāḥ śivavatsaumyadarśanāḥ ..
svarge vasaṃti suciraṃ bhāvitāḥ svena karmaṇā .. 4.89.50 ..
4.89.d:
सर्वसौख्यसमायुक्ताः शिववत्सौम्यदर्शनाः ॥
स्वर्गे वसंति सुचिरं भाविताः स्वेन कर्मणा ॥ 4.89.50 ॥
4.89.m: endowed with all happiness, gentle-looking like Śiva, / purified by their own deed, they dwell in heaven for a very long time.

4.89.s:
snāpya trayodaśa munīnghṛtapāyasena saṃpūjya pūjyatilataṇḍulavastradānaiḥ ..
kurvaṃti ye vratamidaṃ tridaśehni pūtāḥ paśyaṃti te yamamukhaṃ na kadācideva .. 51 .. ..
anaṅgatrayodaśīvratavarṇanam
4.89.d:
स्नाप्य त्रयोदश मुनीन्घृतपायसेन संपूज्य पूज्यतिलतण्डुलवस्त्रदानैः ॥
कुर्वंति ये व्रतमिदं त्रिदशेह्नि पूताः पश्यंति ते यममुखं न कदाचिदेव ॥ 51 ॥ ॥
अनङ्गत्रयोदशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.89.m:
Having bathed thirteen sages and worshipped them with ghee and milk-rice, / with gifts of venerable sesame, rice, and garments, / those who perform this votive observance on the thirteenth day, purified, never behold the face of Yama.
Description of the Anaṅgatrayodaśī Vow

4.90.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
vrataṃ kathaya kiñcinme rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam .. 1 ..
4.90.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्भूतभव्येश संसारार्णवतारक ॥
व्रतं कथय किञ्चिन्मे रूपसौभाग्यदायकम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.90.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, lord of the past and future, ferryman across the ocean of worldly existence, / tell me of some votive observance that grants beauty and good fortune.

4.90.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kiṃ kṛtairbahubhiḥ pārtha vratairunmattaceṣṭitaiḥ ..
kāyakleśakaraiḥ krūrairasāraiḥ phala sādhanaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.90.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
किं कृतैर्बहुभिः पार्थ व्रतैरुन्मत्तचेष्टितैः ॥
कायक्लेशकरैः क्रूरैरसारैः फल साधनैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.90.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / What is the use of performing many votive observances, O Pārtha, which are like the actions of madmen, / causing distress to the body, cruel, unsubstantial, and difficult means of achieving fruits?

4.90.s:
varamekāpi varadā kṛtānaṃgatrayodaśī ..
prasiddhiṃ samanuprāptā martye kāmapradāyinī .. 3 ..
4.90.d:
वरमेकापि वरदा कृतानंगत्रयोदशी ॥
प्रसिद्धिं समनुप्राप्ता मर्त्ये कामप्रदायिनी ॥ 3 ॥
4.90.m: Better is this single boon-bestowing Anaṅgatrayodaśī, when performed, / which has attained renown among mortals, granting desires,

4.90.s:
saubhāgyārogyajayadā sarvātaṃkanivāriṇī ..
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanī sarvamaṃgalavardhanī .. 4 ..
4.90.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यजयदा सर्वातंकनिवारिणी ॥
सर्वदुष्टोपशमनी सर्वमंगलवर्धनी ॥ 4 ॥
4.90.m: giving good fortune, health, and victory, dispelling all fear, / pacifying all wicked things, and increasing all auspiciousness.

4.90.s:
śṛṇuṣva tāṃ mahābāho kathayāmi savistaram ..
purā dagdhena kāmena trinetranayanāgninā .. 5 ..
4.90.d:
शृणुष्व तां महाबाहो कथयामि सविस्तरम् ॥
पुरा दग्धेन कामेन त्रिनेत्रनयनाग्निना ॥ 5 ॥
4.90.m: Listen to it, O mighty-armed one, I shall tell it in full. / Formerly, when Kāma was burned by the fire of the three-eyed god's eye,

4.90.s:
bhasmībhūtena lokānāṃ saṃkalpitā purānagha ..
anaṃgena kathā hyeṣā tenānaṃgatrayodaśī .. 6 ..
4.90.d:
भस्मीभूतेन लोकानां संकल्पिता पुरानघ ॥
अनंगेन कथा ह्येषा तेनानंगत्रयोदशी ॥ 6 ॥
4.90.m: and turned to ashes, he resolved it for the worlds in ancient times, O sinless one; / this story is indeed about Anaṅga, therefore it is Anaṅgatrayodaśī.

4.90.s:
hemaṃte samanuprāpte māsi mārgaśire śubhe ..
śuklapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 7 ..
4.90.d:
हेमंते समनुप्राप्ते मासि मार्गशिरे शुभे ॥
शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदश्यां सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 7 ॥
4.90.m: When winter has arrived, in the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, / on the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight, fasting and with senses conquered,

4.90.s:
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge ca gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ..
kṛtvā samabhyarcya vibhuṃ vidhinā śaśiśekharam ..8..
4.90.d:
स्नानं नद्यां तडागे च गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ॥
कृत्वा समभ्यर्च्य विभुं विधिना शशिशेखरम् ॥8॥
4.90.m: bathing in a river, in a pond, or at home, self-restrained, / having worshipped according to rule the all-pervading lord who bears the crescent moon,

4.90.s:
dhūpadīpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaistathā ..
śaṃbhunāmānyathoccārya homaḥ kāryastilākṣataiḥ .. 9 ..
4.90.d:
धूपदीपैः सनैवेद्यैः पुष्पैः कालोद्भवैस्तथा ॥
शंभुनामान्यथोच्चार्य होमः कार्यस्तिलाक्षतैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.90.m: with incense, lamps, food-offerings, and seasonal flowers, / and then reciting the names of Śambhu, a fire-offering should be made with sesame seeds and unbroken grains.

4.90.s:
anaṃganāmnā saṃpūjya madhu prāśya svapenniśi ..
naivedyairmadhurairdivyaiḥ susvādairghṛtapācitaiḥ .. 4.90.10 ..
4.90.d:
अनंगनाम्ना संपूज्य मधु प्राश्य स्वपेन्निशि ॥
नैवेद्यैर्मधुरैर्दिव्यैः सुस्वादैर्घृतपाचितैः ॥ 4.90.10 ॥
4.90.m: Having worshipped under the name of Anaṅga, tasting honey, one should sleep at night; / with sweet, divine, delicious food-offerings cooked in ghee,

4.90.s:
dhūpaṃ sugaṃdhiṃ dadyācca raktapuṣpaistu pūjanam ..
raṃbhātulyā bhavetsā tu rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 11 ..
4.90.d:
धूपं सुगंधिं दद्याच्च रक्तपुष्पैस्तु पूजनम् ॥
रंभातुल्या भवेत्सा तु रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥ 11 ॥
4.90.m: one should offer fragrant incense, and perform worship with red flowers. / That woman becomes equal to Rambhā, endowed with beauty and youth,

4.90.s:
madhuvatsyātsamadhuraḥ kāmarūpadharastathā ..
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 12 ..
4.90.d:
मधुवत्स्यात्समधुरः कामरूपधरस्तथा ॥
दशानामश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 12 ॥
4.90.m: and [a man] becomes sweet like honey and assumes forms at will; / a person obtains the fruit of ten horse-sacrifices.

4.90.s:
puṣyamāsasya caivoktaṃ caṃdanaṃ prāśayanniśi ..
yogeśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 13 ..
4.90.d:
पुष्यमासस्य चैवोक्तं चंदनं प्राशयन्निशि ॥
योगेश्वरं तु संपूज्य मालतीकुसुमैः शुभैः ॥ 13 ॥
4.90.m: For the month of Pauṣa, it is prescribed that one consume sandalwood at night; / having worshipped Yogeśvara with auspicious mālatī flowers,

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūrāśca damaśāntāstu tāḥ striyaḥ ..
saumyaśītasugandhāśca candanaprāśanodbhavaiḥ .. 14 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं घृतपूराश्च दमशान्तास्तु ताः स्त्रियः ॥
सौम्यशीतसुगन्धाश्च चन्दनप्राशनोद्भवैः ॥ 14 ॥
4.90.m: with food-offerings and ghee cakes, those women, subdued and peaceful, / become gentle, cool, and fragrant from consuming the sandalwood.

4.90.s:
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ..
māghe naṭeśvaraṃ nāma pūjayetpaṃkajena tu .. 15 ..
4.90.d:
राजसूयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥
माघे नटेश्वरं नाम पूजयेत्पंकजेन तु ॥ 15 ॥
4.90.m: One obtains the unexcelled fruit of the Rājasūya sacrifice. / In Māgha, one should worship the one named Naṭeśvara with a lotus,

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ kṣīrakhaṇḍādyairmauktikaṃ prāśayenniśi ..
bahuputrā bhavetsā tu dhanaṃ saubhāgyamuttamam .. 16 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं क्षीरखण्डाद्यैर्मौक्तिकं प्राशयेन्निशि ॥
बहुपुत्रा भवेत्सा तु धनं सौभाग्यमुत्तमम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.90.m: with food-offerings of condensed milk, sugar, and the like, and consume pearl [powder] at night; / that woman will have many sons, wealth, and supreme good fortune,

4.90.s:
muktācūrṇanibhairnetrairyadvā syāttadvadeva hi ..
gaurītulyā bhavetsā tu komalāṃgī prajāyate .. 17 ..
4.90.d:
मुक्ताचूर्णनिभैर्नेत्रैर्यद्वा स्यात्तद्वदेव हि ॥
गौरीतुल्या भवेत्सा तु कोमलांगी प्रजायते ॥ 17 ॥
4.90.m: with eyes resembling pearl powder, or whatever she desires, just so it becomes; / she becomes equal to Gaurī and is born tender-limbed.

4.90.s:
tapta jāṃbūnadābhāso bhaveddivyatanurmahān ..
gomedhasya sahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 18 ..
4.90.d:
तप्त जांबूनदाभासो भवेद्दिव्यतनुर्महान् ॥
गोमेधस्य सहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 18 ॥
4.90.m: A man becomes great, endowed with a divine body, shining like molten gold; / he obtains the fruit of a thousand cow-sacrifices.

4.90.s:
phālgune māsi saṃpūjya devadevaṃ hareśvaram ..
karṇikārasya puṣpāṇi naivedye bījapūrakam .. 19 ..
4.90.d:
फाल्गुने मासि संपूज्य देवदेवं हरेश्वरम् ॥
कर्णिकारस्य पुष्पाणि नैवेद्ये बीजपूरकम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.90.m: In the month of Phālguna, having worshipped Hareśvara, the god of gods, / with karṇikāra flowers, and a citron for the food-offering,

4.90.s:
kaṃkolaṃ prāśayedrātrau sauṃdaryamatulaṃ labhet ..
caitre surūpakaṃ nāma pūjayeddamanena tu .. 4.90.20 ..
4.90.d:
कंकोलं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ सौंदर्यमतुलं लभेत् ॥
चैत्रे सुरूपकं नाम पूजयेद्दमनेन तु ॥ 4.90.20 ॥
4.90.m: one should consume kankola at night and obtain incomparable beauty. / In Caitra, one should worship the one named Surūpaka with damana [leaves],

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ dhūpakaṃ dadyādghṛtakhaṇḍavipācitam ..
karpūraṃ prāśayedrātrau saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt .. 21 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं धूपकं दद्याद्घृतखण्डविपाचितम् ॥
कर्पूरं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ सौभाग्यं महदाप्नुयात् ॥ 21 ॥
4.90.m: give a food-offering and incense cooked with ghee and sugar candy, / and consume camphor at night; one obtains great good fortune.

4.90.s:
candraśca candrakāṃtiśca candravartyaharāvṛte ..
naramedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti śobhanam .. 22 ..
4.90.d:
चन्द्रश्च चन्द्रकांतिश्च चन्द्रवर्त्यहरावृते ॥
नरमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति शोभनम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.90.m: Shining like the moon and with the splendour of the moon, enveloped in lunar wick-cloth, / one obtains the splendid fruit of a human sacrifice.

4.90.s:
vaiśākhe ca mahārūpaṃ puṣpairnaumālikārcanam ..
kāraṃbakaistu naivedyaṃ dātavyaṃ cātiśobhanam .. 23 ..
4.90.d:
वैशाखे च महारूपं पुष्पैर्नौमालिकार्चनम् ॥
कारंबकैस्तु नैवेद्यं दातव्यं चातिशोभनम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.90.m: And in Vaiśākha, worshipping Mahārūpa with navamālikā flowers, / an exceedingly beautiful food-offering of mixed grains should be given.

4.90.s:
jātīphalaṃ tu saṃprāśya jātimāpnotyanuttamām ..
saphalāstasya sarvāśā bhavaṃti bhuvi bhārata .. 24 ..
4.90.d:
जातीफलं तु संप्राश्य जातिमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
सफलास्तस्य सर्वाशा भवंति भुवि भारत ॥ 24 ॥
4.90.m: Having consumed nutmeg, one attains the highest caste; / all his desires become fruitful on earth, O Bhārata.

4.90.s:
gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya brahmaloke mahīyate ..
jyeṣṭhe māse tu pradyumnaṃ pūjayenmallikāsumaiḥ .. 25 ..
4.90.d:
गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥
ज्येष्ठे मासे तु प्रद्युम्नं पूजयेन्मल्लिकासुमैः ॥ 25 ॥
4.90.m: Obtaining the fruit of a thousand cows, he is exalted in the world of Brahmā. / In the month of Jyeṣṭha, one should worship Pradyumna with jasmine flowers,

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ khaṇḍavartiṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ prāśayenniśi ..
jyeṣṭhaṃ padamavāpnoti tathā lakṣmīṃ janārdanāt .. 26 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं खण्डवर्तिं च लवंगं प्राशयेन्निशि ॥
ज्येष्ठं पदमवाप्नोति तथा लक्ष्मीं जनार्दनात् ॥ 26 ॥
4.90.m: give a food-offering of candied wicks, and consume clove at night; / one attains the highest station, and likewise prosperity from Janārdana.

4.90.s:
sarva saukhyasamopetaḥ sthitvā bhuvi śataṃ samāḥ ..
vājapeyasya yajñasya śatamaṣṭaguṇottaram .. 27 ..
4.90.d:
सर्व सौख्यसमोपेतः स्थित्वा भुवि शतं समाः ॥
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य शतमष्टगुणोत्तरम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.90.m: Endowed with all happiness, having dwelt on earth for a hundred years, / [one obtains] eight times the fruit of a hundred Vājapeya sacrifices.

4.90.s:
āṣāḍhe caiva saṃprāpte umābhartāramarcayet ..
puṣpa dhūpādinaivedyaiḥ prāśnīyācca tilodakam .. 28 ..
4.90.d:
आषाढे चैव संप्राप्ते उमाभर्तारमर्चयेत् ॥
पुष्प धूपादिनैवेद्यैः प्राश्नीयाच्च तिलोदकम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.90.m: And when Āṣāḍha arrives, one should worship the husband of Umā / with flowers, incense, food-offerings and the like, and drink sesame water.

4.90.s:
tilottamā rūpadharā sukhī syāccharadaḥ śatam ..
śrāvaṇe umāpatiṃ nāma tilapuṣpaistu pūjayet .. .. 29 ..
4.90.d:
तिलोत्तमा रूपधरा सुखी स्याच्छरदः शतम् ॥
श्रावणे उमापतिं नाम तिलपुष्पैस्तु पूजयेत् ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
4.90.m: Possessing the beauty of Tilottamā, she will be happy for a hundred autumns. / In Śrāvaṇa, one should worship the one named Umāpati with sesame blossoms,

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ laḍḍukāndadyātkṛṣṇāṃśca prāśayettilān ..
pauṃḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanākulam .. 4.90.30 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं लड्डुकान्दद्यात्कृष्णांश्च प्राशयेत्तिलान् ॥
पौंडरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनाकुलम् ॥ 4.90.30 ॥
4.90.m: give laddukas as a food-offering, and consume black sesame seeds; / one obtains the tranquil fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

4.90.s:
tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syācchatrupakṣa kṣayaṃkaraḥ ..
sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade pūjya kuṃkumakeśaraiḥ .. 31 ..
4.90.d:
तदंते राजराजः स्याच्छत्रुपक्ष क्षयंकरः ॥
सद्योजातं भाद्रपदे पूज्य कुंकुमकेशरैः ॥ 31 ॥
4.90.m: At the end of that, he becomes a king of kings, destroying the faction of his enemies. / Having worshipped Sadyojāta in Bhādrapada with saffron filaments,

4.90.s:
naivedyaṃ solikāṃ dadyātprāśayedaguruṃ niśi ..
aguruṃ prāśayitvā tu gururbhavati bhūtale.. .. 32 ..
4.90.d:
नैवेद्यं सोलिकां दद्यात्प्राशयेदगुरुं निशि ॥
अगुरुं प्राशयित्वा तु गुरुर्भवति भूतले॥ ॥ 32 ॥
4.90.m: one should give solikā pastries as a food-offering, and consume agarwood at night; / having consumed agarwood, he becomes weighty on earth.

4.90.s:
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto bhuktvā bhogānmano'nugān ..
uktayajñaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 33 ..
4.90.d:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो भुक्त्वा भोगान्मनोऽनुगान् ॥
उक्तयज्ञफलं प्राप्य विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 33 ॥
4.90.m: Surrounded by sons and grandsons, having enjoyed pleasures according to his heart's desire, / and obtained the declared fruit of the sacrifice, he is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu.

4.90.s:
tridaśādhipatimaśvayuji pūjya sindūrakavrajaiḥ ..
svarṇādikaṃ tu saṃprāśya svarṇavarṇaḥ prajāyate ..34..
4.90.d:
त्रिदशाधिपतिमश्वयुजि पूज्य सिन्दूरकव्रजैः ॥
स्वर्णादिकं तु संप्राश्य स्वर्णवर्णः प्रजायते ॥34॥
4.90.m: In Āśvayuja, having worshipped the lord of the gods with clusters of vermilion flowers, / and consumed gold and the like, one becomes gold-complexioned.

4.90.s:
rūpavānsubhago vāgmī bhuktvā bhogānmahītale ..
suvarṇakoṭidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 35 ..
4.90.d:
रूपवान्सुभगो वाग्मी भुक्त्वा भोगान्महीतले ॥
सुवर्णकोटिदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 35 ॥
4.90.m: Handsome, fortunate, eloquent, having enjoyed pleasures on the earth, / a person obtains the fruit of giving ten million gold pieces.

4.90.s:
viśveśvaraṃ kārttike tu sarvapuṣpaistu pūjayet ..
damanasya phalaṃ prāśya damanena pumānbhavet .. 36 ..
4.90.d:
विश्वेश्वरं कार्त्तिके तु सर्वपुष्पैस्तु पूजयेत् ॥
दमनस्य फलं प्राश्य दमनेन पुमान्भवेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.90.m: In Kārttika, one should worship Viśveśvara with all kinds of flowers; / having consumed the fruit of the damana plant, a man becomes a subduer.

4.90.s:
damanonmādakartā ca sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ ..
bhavedbhujabalopetastataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 37 ..
4.90.d:
दमनोन्मादकर्ता च सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुः ॥
भवेद्भुजबलोपेतस्ततः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.90.m: He becomes a subduer and infatuator, master of the whole universe, / endowed with the strength of arms; and thereafter he goes to the realm of Śiva.

4.90.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte pārite'sminvratottame ..
yatkartavyaṃ tadadhunā śrūyatāṃ kurunaṃdana .. 38 ..
4.90.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते पारितेऽस्मिन्व्रतोत्तमे ॥
यत्कर्तव्यं तदधुना श्रूयतां कुरुनंदन ॥ 38 ॥
4.90.m: Thus, when this supreme votive observance has been completed at the end of the year, / hear now, O delight of the Kurus, what should be done.

4.90.s:
vrate vidhno yadā ca syādaśaktyā sūtakena vā ..
upoṣyamevopavasettadā drumapuraḥ punaḥ .. 39 ..
4.90.d:
व्रते विध्नो यदा च स्यादशक्त्या सूतकेन वा ॥
उपोष्यमेवोपवसेत्तदा द्रुमपुरः पुनः ॥ 39 ॥
4.90.m: If there should be an obstacle to the observance through incapacity or childbirth pollution, / he should then fast on the day of fasting again in front of the tree.

4.90.s:
pūrvoktamevaṃ nirvartya sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchivam ..
tāmrapātre tu saṃsthāpya kalaśopari vinyaset .. 4.90.40 ..
4.90.d:
पूर्वोक्तमेवं निर्वर्त्य सौवर्णं कारयेच्छिवम् ॥
ताम्रपात्रे तु संस्थाप्य कलशोपरि विन्यसेत् ॥ 4.90.40 ॥
4.90.m: Having performed as stated before in this manner, he should have a golden image of Śiva made, / and placing it in a copper vessel, he should set it upon a water-pot.

4.90.s:
śuklavastreṇa saṃchādya puṣpanaivedyapūjitam ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śivabhaktāya suvrata .. .. 41 ..
4.90.d:
शुक्लवस्त्रेण संछाद्य पुष्पनैवेद्यपूजितम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्यं शिवभक्ताय सुव्रत ॥ ॥ 41 ॥
4.90.m: Having covered it with a white cloth, worshipped with flowers and food-offerings, / it must be given to a Brahmin who is devoted to Śiva, O you of noble vows.

4.90.s:
śaktimāñchayanaṃ dadyādgāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīm ..
chatropānatpradātavyaṃ kalaśāḥ sodakāstathā .. 42 ..
4.90.d:
शक्तिमाञ्छयनं दद्याद्गां सवत्सां पयस्विनीम् ॥
छत्रोपानत्प्रदातव्यं कलशाः सोदकास्तथा ॥ 42 ॥
4.90.m: A capable person should give a bed, a milch cow together with her calf; / a royal parasol and shoes should be given, as well as water-pots filled with water.

4.90.s:
śāṃtāśca kecidicchaṃti śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..
pañcāmṛtena snānaṃ ca tasminnahani kārayet .. 43 ..
4.90.d:
शांताश्च केचिदिच्छंति शक्त्या दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
पञ्चामृतेन स्नानं च तस्मिन्नहनि कारयेत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.90.m: Some desire quiet [reciters of mantras]; and he should give a priestly gift according to his ability; / and on that day he should cause a bath with the five ambrosias to be performed

4.90.s:
devadevasya rājendra puṣpadīpānnasaṃyutam ..
bhojanaṃ ca yathā śaktyā ṣaḍrasaṃ madhurottaram .. 44 ..
4.90.d:
देवदेवस्य राजेन्द्र पुष्पदीपान्नसंयुतम् ॥
भोजनं च यथा शक्त्या षड्रसं मधुरोत्तरम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.90.m: for the god of gods, O lord of kings, accompanied by flowers, lamps, and cooked food. / And according to his ability, a meal with the six tastes, predominantly sweet,

4.90.s:
pradadyācchivabhaktebhyo viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā ..
evaṃ nirvartya vidhivatkṛtakṛtyaḥ pumānbhavet .. 45 ..
4.90.d:
प्रदद्याच्छिवभक्तेभ्यो विशुद्धेनांतरात्मना ॥
एवं निर्वर्त्य विधिवत्कृतकृत्यः पुमान्भवेत् ॥ 45 ॥
4.90.m: he should offer to the devotees of Śiva with a purified inner self. / Having thus accomplished this according to the rule, a man becomes one who has attained his purpose.

4.90.s:
nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha kumārī vā yatavratā ..
pārite tu vrate paścātkuryācca sumahotsavam .. 46 ..
4.90.d:
नारी वा भरतश्रेष्ठ कुमारी वा यतव्रता ॥
पारिते तु व्रते पश्चात्कुर्याच्च सुमहोत्सवम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.90.m: A woman or an unmarried girl of disciplined vows, O best of the Bharatas, / should also make a very great festival after the observance is completed.

4.90.s:
anena vidhinā kuryādyastvanaṃgatrayodaśīm ..
sa rājyaṃ nihatāmitraṃ kīrtimāyuryaśo balam .. 47 ..
4.90.d:
अनेन विधिना कुर्याद्यस्त्वनंगत्रयोदशीम् ॥
स राज्यं निहतामित्रं कीर्तिमायुर्यशो बलम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.90.m: Whoever performs the Anaṅgatrayodaśī according to this rule, / he [obtains] a kingdom with slain enemies, fame, long life, renown, strength,

4.90.s:
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti yāvajjanmaśataṃ nṛpa ..
tato nirvāṇamāyāti śivalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 48 ..
4.90.d:
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति यावज्जन्मशतं नृप ॥
ततो निर्वाणमायाति शिवलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 48 ॥
4.90.m: and attains great good fortune for a hundred births, O king; / thereafter he reaches liberation and goes to the world of Śiva.

4.90.s:
kāmena yā kila purā samupoṣitāsīcchubhrā tithistridaśamī suśubhāṃgahetoḥ ..
tāṃ prāśanairuditanāmayutairupetā kṛtvā prayāti paramaṃ padamiṃdumauleḥ .. .. 49 ..
pālīvratavarṇanam
4.90.d:
कामेन या किल पुरा समुपोषितासीच्छुभ्रा तिथिस्त्रिदशमी सुशुभांगहेतोः ॥
तां प्राशनैरुदितनामयुतैरुपेता कृत्वा प्रयाति परमं पदमिंदुमौलेः ॥ ॥ 49 ॥
पालीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.90.m:
That bright thirteenth lunar day which was anciently fasted by Kāma for the sake of an auspicious body, / having observed it along with the ingesting of the specified names, one goes to the supreme abode of the moon-crested god.
Description of the Pālī Votive Observance

4.91.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ambupūrṇataḍāgeṣu mahātoyāśayeṣu ca ..
kasyārthaṃ samprayacchaṃti kṛṣṇaitāḥ kulayoṣitaḥ .. 1 ..
4.91.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अम्बुपूर्णतडागेषु महातोयाशयेषु च ॥
कस्यार्थं सम्प्रयच्छंति कृष्णैताः कुलयोषितः ॥ 1 ॥
4.91.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / In water-filled ponds and in vast reservoirs, / for what purpose, O Kṛṣṇa, do these women of noble family make offerings?

4.91.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. .
māsi bhādrapade prāpte śukle bhūtatithau nṛpa ..
taḍāgapālyāṃ dātavyaṃ varuṇāyārghyamuttamam .. 2 ..
4.91.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ।
मासि भाद्रपदे प्राप्ते शुक्ले भूततिथौ नृप ॥
तडागपाल्यां दातव्यं वरुणायार्घ्यमुत्तमम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.91.m: The glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / When the month of Bhādrapada arrives, in the bright fortnight on the fourteenth lunar day, O king, / an excellent water offering should be given to Varuṇa on the embankment of a pond.

4.91.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhistathaiva ca ..
tasmindine bhaktinamrairdeyādarghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 3 ..
4.91.d:
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैः स्त्रीभिस्तथैव च ॥
तस्मिन्दिने भक्तिनम्रैर्देयादर्घ्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥ 3 ॥
4.91.m: By Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, and likewise by women, / bowed down in devotion on that day, a water offering should be given, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
with flowers, fruits, clothes, lamps, red lac, and sandalpastes, / with food cooked without fire, mixed with sesame and husked rice,
with dates, coconuts, and citrons, / with grapes, pomegranates, betel nuts, and cucumbers one should worship.

4.91.s:
ālikhya maṇḍale devaṃ varuṇaṃ vāruṇīyutam ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ .. .. 6 ..
4.91.d:
आलिख्य मण्डले देवं वरुणं वारुणीयुतम् ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र पूजयेद्भक्तिभावतः ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
4.91.m: Having drawn god Varuṇa together with Vāruṇī in a sacred circle, / he should worship him with devotion with this mantra, O lord of kings:

4.91.s:
varuṇāya namastubhyaṃ namaste yādasāṃpate ..
apāṃpate namaste'stu rasānāṃpataye namaḥ .. 7 ..
4.91.d:
वरुणाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते यादसांपते ॥
अपांपते नमस्तेऽस्तु रसानांपतये नमः ॥ 7 ॥
4.91.m: "Obeisance to you, Varuṇa; obeisance to you, lord of aquatic creatures! / Obeisance be to you, lord of waters; obeisance to the lord of tastes!

4.91.s:
mā kledaṃ mā ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ virasyaṃ mā mukhe'stu me ..
varuṇo vāruṇībhartā varado'stu sadā mama ( svāhā) .. 8 ..
4.91.d:
मा क्लेदं मा च दौर्गंध्यं विरस्यं मा मुखेऽस्तु मे ॥
वरुणो वारुणीभर्ता वरदोऽस्तु सदा मम ( स्वाहा) ॥ 8 ॥
4.91.m: Let there be no dampness, no foul smell, no tastelessness in my mouth. / May Varuṇa, the husband of Vāruṇī, ever be the granter of boons to me. Svāhā."

4.91.s:
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā varuṇaṃ varuṇālayam ..
madhyāhne sarasi snātvā nagnipākī vratī nṛpa .. 9 ..
4.91.d:
एवं यः पूजयेद्भक्त्या वरुणं वरुणालयम् ॥
मध्याह्ने सरसि स्नात्वा नग्निपाकी व्रती नृप ॥ 9 ॥
4.91.m: He who with devotion thus worships Varuṇa who has the waters as his abode, / having bathed at noon in a lake, eating only food cooked without fire, the observant person, O king,

4.91.s:
cāturvarṇyatha vai nārī vratenānena pāṃḍava ..
naivedyaṃ brāhmaṇe deyaṃ yannaivedye prakalpitam .. 4.91.10 ..
4.91.d:
चातुर्वर्ण्यथ वै नारी व्रतेनानेन पांडव ॥
नैवेद्यं ब्राह्मणे देयं यन्नैवेद्ये प्रकल्पितम् ॥ 4.91.10 ॥
4.91.m: or a woman of the four classes, by this observance, O son of Pāṇḍu, / should give the food-offering to a Brahmin, whatever was prepared for the food-offering.

4.91.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha pālīvratamuttamam ..
tatkṣaṇātsarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
4.91.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ पालीव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
तत्क्षणात्सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 11 ॥
4.91.m: Whoever, O son of Pṛthā, performs this supreme embankment observance in this manner, / is instantly freed from all sins; there is no doubt about this.

4.91.s:
saṃruddhaśuddhasalilātibalāṃ viśālāṃ pālīmupetya bahubhistarubhiḥ kṛtālīm ..
ye pūjayaṃti varuṇaṃ sahitaṃ samudraisteṣāṃ gṛhe bhavati bhūtiralabdhanāśā .. 12 ..
rambhāvratavarṇanam
4.91.d:
संरुद्धशुद्धसलिलातिबलां विशालां पालीमुपेत्य बहुभिस्तरुभिः कृतालीम् ॥
ये पूजयंति वरुणं सहितं समुद्रैस्तेषां गृहे भवति भूतिरलब्धनाशा ॥ 12 ॥
रम्भाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.91.m:
Having approached the very strong, wide embankment holding back pure water, lined with many trees, / those who worship Varuṇa together with the ocean—in their home prosperity never suffers destruction.
Description of the Rambhā Votive Observance

4.92.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
asminneva dine pārtha śṛṇu brahmasabhātale ..
devalena purā gītaṃ devarṣigaṇasannidhau .. 1 ..
4.92.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अस्मिन्नेव दिने पार्थ शृणु ब्रह्मसभातले ॥
देवलेन पुरा गीतं देवर्षिगणसन्निधौ ॥ 1 ॥
4.92.m: The glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / On this very day, O son of Pṛthā, hear what was sung of old by Devala / in the assembly hall of Brahmā in the presence of the assembly of divine sages,

4.92.s:
apsarogaṇagaṃdharvairdevaiḥ sarvaiḥ samarcitam ..
saṃsārāsāratāṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrasthakadalīdrume ..
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade nṛpa .. 2 ..
4.92.d:
अप्सरोगणगंधर्वैर्देवैः सर्वैः समर्चितम् ॥
संसारासारतां दृष्ट्वा तत्रस्थकदलीद्रुमे ॥
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां मासि भाद्रपदे नृप ॥ 2 ॥
4.92.m: worshipped by all the gods together with the celestial nymphs and gandharvas, / seeing the unsubstantial nature of saṃsāra, at a plantain tree situated there, / in the bright fortnight on the fourteenth lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada, O king:

4.92.s:
dattamarghyaṃ varastrībhiḥ phalairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca dīpālaktakacandanaiḥ .. 3 ..
4.92.d:
दत्तमर्घ्यं वरस्त्रीभिः फलैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः ॥
विरूढैः सप्तधान्यैश्च दीपालक्तकचन्दनैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.92.m: A water offering was given by noble women with various auspicious fruits, / with sprouted seven grains, lamps, red lac, and sandalpastes,
with curd, dūrvā grass, unbroken rice grains, garments, food-offerings cooked in clarified butter, / with nutmegs, cloves, cardamom, and lavalī fruits,

4.92.s:
kadalaiḥ kandarabhaṭairmocā sātra nigadyate ..
tasminnahani dātavyaṃ strībhiḥ sarvābhirapyalam .. 5 ..
4.92.d:
कदलैः कन्दरभटैर्मोचा सात्र निगद्यते ॥
तस्मिन्नहनि दातव्यं स्त्रीभिः सर्वाभिरप्यलम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.92.m: with plantains and bulb-roots—mocā is spoken of here— / on that day, it must abundantly be given by all women.

4.92.s:
maṃtre ṇānena caivārghyaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca narādhipa ..
cityā tvaṃ kandaladalaiḥ kadale kāmadāyini ..
śarīrārogyalāvaṇyaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te .. 6 ..
4.92.d:
मंत्रे णानेन चैवार्घ्यं शृणुष्व च नराधिप ॥
चित्या त्वं कन्दलदलैः कदले कामदायिनि ॥
शरीरारोग्यलावण्यं देहि देवि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 6 ॥
4.92.m: And with this mantra the water offering [is given]; hear it, O ruler of men: / "You who are heaped up with sprout-leaves, O plantain, bestower of desires, / grant health and beauty to my body; O goddess, obeisance be to you!"

4.92.s:
itthaṃ yaḥ pūjayedrājā puruṣo bhaktimānnṛpa ..
nārī vānagnipākāṃtā cāturvarṇyā yudhiṣṭhira .. 7 ..
4.92.d:
इत्थं यः पूजयेद्राजा पुरुषो भक्तिमान्नृप ॥
नारी वानग्निपाकांता चातुर्वर्ण्या युधिष्ठिर ॥ 7 ॥
4.92.m: In this way, whether a king or a devout man worships, O king, / or a woman of the four classes who eats food not cooked by fire, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.92.s:
tasyāḥ kule na bhavati kvacinnārī kulāṭanī ..
durgatā durbhagā vaṃdhyā svairiṇī pāpakāriṇī .. 8 ..
4.92.d:
तस्याः कुले न भवति क्वचिन्नारी कुलाटनी ॥
दुर्गता दुर्भगा वंध्या स्वैरिणी पापकारिणी ॥ 8 ॥
4.92.m: in her lineage there is never a loose woman, / an impoverished woman, an unfortunate one, a barren woman, an unchaste one, an evil-doer,

4.92.s:
vilāsinī vā vṛṣalī punarbhūḥ punaretasī ..
gaṇikā svairiṇī voḍhā mūlyakarmakarī khalā .. 9 ..
4.92.d:
विलासिनी वा वृषली पुनर्भूः पुनरेतसी ॥
गणिका स्वैरिणी वोढा मूल्यकर्मकरी खला ॥ 9 ॥
4.92.m: a coquettish woman, an outcast woman, a remarried widow, a woman who receives seed again, / a courtesan, an adulteress, a bought woman, a hireling, a deceitful woman;

4.92.s:
bhartṛ vratātpracalitā na kadācitprajāyate ..
bhavetsaubhāgyasaukhyāḍhyā putrapautraistathāvṛtā ..
āyuṣmatī kīrtimatī ramedvarṣaśatairbhuvi .. 4.92.10 ..
4.92.d:
भर्तृ व्रतात्प्रचलिता न कदाचित्प्रजायते ॥
भवेत्सौभाग्यसौख्याढ्या पुत्रपौत्रैस्तथावृता ॥
आयुष्मती कीर्तिमती रमेद्वर्षशतैर्भुवि ॥ 4.92.10 ॥
4.92.m: one who swerves from her vow to her husband is never born. / She becomes rich in good fortune and happiness, surrounded by sons and grandsons; / long-lived and renowned, she delights on earth for hundreds of years.

4.92.s:
ekaṃ raṃbhā vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ gāyatryā svargasaṃsthayā ..
tathā gauryā ca kailāsa indrāṇyā naṃdane vane .. 11 ..
4.92.d:
एकं रंभा व्रतं चीर्णं गायत्र्या स्वर्गसंस्थया ॥
तथा गौर्या च कैलास इन्द्राण्या नंदने वने ॥ 11 ॥
4.92.m: This single Rambhā observance was performed by Gāyatrī residing in heaven, / and likewise by Gaurī on Kailāsa, and by Indrāṇī in the Nandana grove.

4.92.s:
śvetadvīpe tathā lakṣmyā rājñyā ca ravimaṃḍale ..
arundhatyā dāruvane svāhayā meruparvate .. 12 ..
4.92.d:
श्वेतद्वीपे तथा लक्ष्म्या राज्ञ्या च रविमंडले ॥
अरुन्धत्या दारुवने स्वाहया मेरुपर्वते ॥ 12 ॥
4.92.m: So too by Lakṣmī in Śvetadvīpa, and by the queen in the solar orb, / by Arundhatī in Dāruvana, and by Svāhā on Mount Meru,

4.92.s:
sītādevyā tvayodhyāyāṃ vedavatyā himācale ..
bhānumatyā nāgapure vratametadanuṣṭhitam.. 13 ..
4.92.d:
सीतादेव्या त्वयोध्यायां वेदवत्या हिमाचले ॥
भानुमत्या नागपुरे व्रतमेतदनुष्ठितम्॥ 13 ॥
4.92.m: by goddess Sītā in Ayodhyā, by Vedavatī in the Himālayas, / and by Bhānumatī in Nāgapura was this votive observance performed.

4.92.s:
etadvrataṃ pārthivendra māsi bhādrapade site ..
yā karoti na sā duḥkhaiḥ kadācidapi pīḍyate ..14..
4.92.d:
एतद्व्रतं पार्थिवेन्द्र मासि भाद्रपदे सिते ॥
या करोति न सा दुःखैः कदाचिदपि पीड्यते ॥14॥
4.92.m: O lord of kings, the woman who performs this votive observance in the bright [fortnight] of the month of Bhādrapada / is never afflicted by miseries.

4.92.s:
saṃbhinnakandakadalī ca manojñarūpāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ ..
tāsāṃ gṛheṣu na bhavaṃti kadācideva nāryastvanāryacaritā vidhavā virūpāḥ ..15..
āgneyīcaturdaśīvratavarṇanam
4.92.d:
संभिन्नकन्दकदली च मनोज्ञरूपां याः पूजयंति कुसुमाक्षतधूपदीपैः ॥
तासां गृहेषु न भवंति कदाचिदेव नार्यस्त्वनार्यचरिता विधवा विरूपाः ॥15॥
आग्नेयीचतुर्दशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.92.m:
Women who worship the plantain tree of charming form with its clustered tubers with flowers, unbroken grains of rice, incense, and lamps / never have in their households women of ignoble conduct, widows, or deformed women.
Description of the Āgneyī Caturdaśī Vrata

4.93.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
caturdaśī mahārāja hutabhugdayitā śubhā ..
naṣṭastadā havyavāhaḥ punarastitvamāptavān .. 1 ..
4.93.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
चतुर्दशी महाराज हुतभुग्दयिता शुभा ॥
नष्टस्तदा हव्यवाहः पुनरस्तित्वमाप्तवान् ॥ 1 ॥
4.93.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
O great king, the auspicious fourteenth [lunar day] is dear to the Fire-God.
Having then vanished, the bearer of oblations regained his existence.

4.93.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamagniḥ purā naṣṭo devakāryepyupasthitaḥ ..
kenāgnitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra kathaṃ hi vidito'nalaḥ ..
etadvadasva deveśa sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava .. 2 ..
4.93.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमग्निः पुरा नष्टो देवकार्येप्युपस्थितः ॥
केनाग्नित्वं कृतं तत्र कथं हि विदितोऽनलः ॥
एतद्वदस्व देवेश सर्वं हि विदितं तव ॥ 2 ॥
4.93.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How was Agni lost of old, even when the business of the gods was at hand?
By whom was the function of fire performed then, and how was the fire discovered?
Tell this, O lord of gods; for everything is known to you.

4.93.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā surā mahārāja tārakeṇa parājitāḥ ..
apṛcchanviśvakartāraṃ tārakaṃ ko vadhiṣyati .. 3 ..
4.93.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा सुरा महाराज तारकेण पराजिताः ॥
अपृच्छन्विश्वकर्तारं तारकं को वधिष्यति ॥ 3 ॥
4.93.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Of old, O great king, the gods, defeated by Tāraka,
asked the Creator of the universe: “Who will slay Tāraka?”

4.93.s:
uvācāsau ciraṃ dhyātvā rudromāśukrasambhavaḥ ..
gaṃgāsvāhāgnitejojaḥ śiśurdaityaṃ vadhiṣyati .. .. 4 ..
4.93.d:
उवाचासौ चिरं ध्यात्वा रुद्रोमाशुक्रसम्भवः ॥
गंगास्वाहाग्नितेजोजः शिशुर्दैत्यं वधिष्यति ॥ ॥ 4 ॥
4.93.m: Having meditated for a long time, he said: “Born from the semen of Rudra and Umā, / born from the splendour of Gaṅgā, Svāhā, and Agni, a child shall slay the Daitya.”

4.93.s:
evaṃ śrutvā gatā devā yatra śambhuḥ sahomayā ..
praṇamya te tamūcurhi yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā tadā .. 5 ..
4.93.d:
एवं श्रुत्वा गता देवा यत्र शम्भुः सहोमया ॥
प्रणम्य ते तमूचुर्हि यदुक्तं ब्रह्मणा तदा ॥ 5 ॥
4.93.m:
Having heard this, the gods went to where Śambhu was with Umā.
Bowing down, they told him indeed what had been spoken by Brahmā then.

4.93.s:
pratipannaṃ ca rudreṇa umayā sahitena tat ..
prayatnamakarottaṃ ca ya uktomarasattamaiḥ .. 6 ..
4.93.d:
प्रतिपन्नं च रुद्रेण उमया सहितेन तत् ॥
प्रयत्नमकरोत्तं च य उक्तोमरसत्तमैः ॥ 6 ॥
4.93.m:
And that was agreed to by Rudra together with Umā.
And he made that effort which had been requested by the best of the immortals.

4.93.s:
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ gataḥ kālo'tha maithune ..
na cāpyuparamastatra tayorāsītkathañcana ..
bhayaṃ ca sumahatteṣāṃ devānāṃ samajāyata .. 7 ..
4.93.d:
दिव्यं वर्षशतं साग्रं गतः कालोऽथ मैथुने ॥
न चाप्युपरमस्तत्र तयोरासीत्कथञ्चन ॥
भयं च सुमहत्तेषां देवानां समजायत ॥ 7 ॥
4.93.m:
A period exceeding a hundred divine years passed in sexual union,
and yet there was no cessation at all between the two of them.
And a very great fear arose among those gods.

4.93.s:
sa rudrasambhavo yo vai bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ..
sa daityāndānavagaṇānvadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
4.93.d:
स रुद्रसम्भवो यो वै भविष्यति महाबलः ॥
स दैत्यान्दानवगणान्वधिष्यति न संशयः ॥ 8 ॥
4.93.m:
“He who will indeed be born of Rudra will be endowed with great strength;
he will slay the Daityas and hordes of Dānavas, without doubt.

4.93.s:
kena kālena bhavati raterviratiretayoḥ ..
etadvicintya prahitau devaistatrānilānalau .. 9 ..
4.93.d:
केन कालेन भवति रतेर्विरतिरेतयोः ॥
एतद्विचिन्त्य प्रहितौ देवैस्तत्रानिलानलौ ॥ 9 ॥
4.93.m:
At what time will the cessation of their lovemaking occur?”
Having pondered this, Wind and Fire were dispatched there by the gods.

4.93.s:
gatau tau comayā dṛṣṭau samasthau viṣamasthayā ..
śaśāpa ca ruṣā devī devāngarbhavivarjitā .. 4.93.10 ..
4.93.d:
गतौ तौ चोमया दृष्टौ समस्थौ विषमस्थया ॥
शशाप च रुषा देवी देवान्गर्भविवर्जिता ॥ 4.93.10 ॥
4.93.m:
The two having arrived, they were seen standing evenly by Umā who was unevenly positioned;
and in anger, deprived of a child, the goddess cursed the gods:

4.93.s:
yasmāttairjanito vighno me'patyārthe divaukasām ..
tasmātte sveṣu dāreṣu janayiṣyanti na prajāḥ ..11..
4.93.d:
यस्मात्तैर्जनितो विघ्नो मेऽपत्यार्थे दिवौकसाम् ॥
तस्मात्ते स्वेषु दारेषु जनयिष्यन्ति न प्रजाः ॥11॥
4.93.m:
“Since an obstacle was created by those gods regarding my offspring,
therefore they shall not beget progeny upon their own wives!”

4.93.s:
athovāca tadā devo devānsarvagaṇāñchanaiḥ..
agnirgṛhṇātu vīryaṃ me saṃbhṛtaṃ suciraṃ hi yat ..12..
4.93.d:
अथोवाच तदा देवो देवान्सर्वगणाञ्छनैः॥
अग्निर्गृह्णातु वीर्यं मे संभृतं सुचिरं हि यत् ॥12॥
4.93.m:
Then the god slowly said to all the hosts of gods:
“Let Agni receive my seed, which has indeed been gathered for so long a time.”

4.93.s:
evamukto'tha rudreṇa naṣṭo'gnirdevasaṃkulāt ..
na svastho na bhuvistho vā na sūryastho na bhūtale ..13..
4.93.d:
एवमुक्तोऽथ रुद्रेण नष्टोऽग्निर्देवसंकुलात् ॥
न स्वस्थो न भुविस्थो वा न सूर्यस्थो न भूतले ॥13॥
4.93.m:
Having been spoken to thus by Rudra, Agni vanished from the assembly of gods;
he was neither in heaven nor on earth, neither in the sun nor on the terrestrial surface.

4.93.s:
devā anveṣaṇe yatnamakurvannagnidarśane ..
kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca aṣṭau ca tridivaukasaḥ .. 14 ..
4.93.d:
देवा अन्वेषणे यत्नमकुर्वन्नग्निदर्शने ॥
कृमिकीटपतंगाश्च अष्टौ च त्रिदिवौकसः ॥ 14 ॥
4.93.m:
The gods made an effort in searching to find Agni—
worms, insects, moths, and eight denizens of heaven:

4.93.s:
haṃsāḥ kekāḥ śukā vahniḥ śīghraṃ śaravaṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
śaśāpāgnirgajā jihvā dviguṇo vā bhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
4.93.d:
हंसाः केकाः शुका वह्निः शीघ्रं शरवणं गताः ॥
शशापाग्निर्गजा जिह्वा द्विगुणो वा भविष्यति ॥ 15 ॥
4.93.m:
Hansas, peacocks, and parrots. Agni swiftly went into a thicket of reeds.
Agni cursed the elephants: “Your tongue shall become twofold!”

4.93.s:
dṛṣṭvātha vibudhāḥ sarve pakṣiṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ varam..
jīvaṃ jīvakanāmānaṃ bhobhoḥ satyaṃ vadasva naḥ..16..
4.93.d:
दृष्ट्वाथ विबुधाः सर्वे पक्षिणं पक्षिणां वरम्॥
जीवं जीवकनामानं भोभोः सत्यं वदस्व नः॥16॥
4.93.m:
Then, seeing a bird, the best of birds,
named Jīva-Jīvaka, all the gods [said]: “O you, tell us the truth!

4.93.s:
kaccidṛṣṭastvayā vahnirvane'sminnaṭatā sadā..
nābhadraṃ nāpi bhadraṃ vā kiñcideva vaco'bravīt ..17..
4.93.d:
कच्चिदृष्टस्त्वया वह्निर्वनेऽस्मिन्नटता सदा॥
नाभद्रं नापि भद्रं वा किञ्चिदेव वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥17॥
4.93.m:
Was Agni perhaps seen by you as you wander always in this forest?”
He did not speak any word, neither inauspicious nor auspicious.

4.93.s:
bhūyobhūyastu pṛṣṭo'pi na gāmuccārayecciram..
tuṣṭastasyābravīdvahnirjīvaṃ jīva vadāmi te ..18..
4.93.d:
भूयोभूयस्तु पृष्टोऽपि न गामुच्चारयेच्चिरम्॥
तुष्टस्तस्याब्रवीद्वह्निर्जीवं जीव वदामि ते ॥18॥
4.93.m:
Though questioned again and again, he would not utter speech for a long time.
Pleased with him, Agni said: “Live, Jīva, I say to you!

4.93.s:
yasmānna kiñciduktaṃ te tasmāccitra tanūruhāḥ ..
jīva jīva punarjīva yāvadicchā tathāyuṣaḥ .. 19 ..
4.93.d:
यस्मान्न किञ्चिदुक्तं ते तस्माच्चित्र तनूरुहाः ॥
जीव जीव पुनर्जीव यावदिच्छा तथायुषः ॥ 19 ॥
4.93.m:
Because nothing was spoken by you, therefore your feathers shall be variegated.
Live, live, live again, as long as your desire for life remains!

4.93.s:
dvitīyaṃ te varaṃ dadmo jīvajīvaka śobhanam ..
vyaktā te mānuṣī vācā spaṣṭārthā ca bhaviṣyati .. 4.93.20 ..
4.93.d:
द्वितीयं ते वरं दद्मो जीवजीवक शोभनम् ॥
व्यक्ता ते मानुषी वाचा स्पष्टार्था च भविष्यति ॥ 4.93.20 ॥
4.93.m:
We grant you a second, excellent boon, O Jīvajīvaka:
your speech shall be human, distinct and clear in meaning.

4.93.s:
kaścidyadi tavādhasthādbudhaḥ snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
vaṃdhyā vā ṣoḍaśābdīyā kṣaṇādbālo bhaviṣyati .. 21 ..
4.93.d:
कश्चिद्यदि तवाधस्थाद्बुधः स्नानं करिष्यति ॥
वंध्या वा षोडशाब्दीया क्षणाद्बालो भविष्यति ॥ 21 ॥
4.93.m:
If any wise person bathes beneath you,
or a barren woman sixteen years old, in an instant a boy will come to be.

4.93.s:
māsaṃ yaśca tṛtīyaṃ vai bhakṣayiṣyatyaniṃditam ..
ajaraḥ so'maraścaiva sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 22 ..
4.93.d:
मासं यश्च तृतीयं वै भक्षयिष्यत्यनिंदितम् ॥
अजरः सोऽमरश्चैव सर्वकालं भविष्यति ॥ 22 ॥
4.93.m:
And he who eats [your meat] in the blameless third month
shall become unaging and immortal for all time.”

4.93.s:
idaṃ dattvā varāṃstasya vahnitvamatha āptavān ..
vibudhā api tatraiva tamadṛśyaṃta vaṃśagam .. 23 ..
4.93.d:
इदं दत्त्वा वरांस्तस्य वह्नित्वमथ आप्तवान् ॥
विबुधा अपि तत्रैव तमदृश्यंत वंशगम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.93.m:
Having given him these boons, [Agni] then regained his fire-nature.
The gods too saw him right there, entered into a bamboo.

4.93.s:
ūṣmayā jātakalmāṣaṃ jñātvā saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
tuṣṭā vaṃśamathocuste devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ .. 24 ..
4.93.d:
ऊष्मया जातकल्माषं ज्ञात्वा संहृष्टमानसः ॥
तुष्टा वंशमथोचुस्ते देवास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः ॥ 24 ॥
4.93.m:
Knowing him to have become spotted from the heat, with delighted minds,
those pleased gods, the lords of the three worlds, then spoke to the bamboo:

4.93.s:
ūṣmayā kalmaṣībhūya hyagnirgarbhaṃ dhariṣyati ..
yo gṛhī vaiṇavīṃ yaṣṭiṃ brahmacārī ca naiṣṭhikaḥ .. 25 ..
4.93.d:
ऊष्मया कल्मषीभूय ह्यग्निर्गर्भं धरिष्यति ॥
यो गृही वैणवीं यष्टिं ब्रह्मचारी च नैष्ठिकः ॥ 25 ॥
4.93.m:
“Having become spotted by the heat, Agni shall indeed bear the embryo.
Whichever householder or lifelong religious student holds a bamboo staff,

4.93.s:
paṃḍāgnipālane puṇyaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ..
vadaṃtaṃ kalmaṣīyaṣṭistaṃ prāpnoti dvijottamam .. 26 ..
4.93.d:
पंडाग्निपालने पुण्यं यद्दृष्टं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥
वदंतं कल्मषीयष्टिस्तं प्राप्नोति द्विजोत्तमम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.93.m:
whatever merit is seen by the exponents of the Veda in maintaining the fire of the altar,
that spotted staff brings to that best of twice-born who speaks [the Veda].”

4.93.s:
vaṃśasyānugrahaṃ kṛtvā devyāhṛtimathābruvan ..
gṛhṇīta śukraṃ bhadrasya tava putro bhaviṣyati .. 27 ..
4.93.d:
वंशस्यानुग्रहं कृत्वा देव्याहृतिमथाब्रुवन् ॥
गृह्णीत शुक्रं भद्रस्य तव पुत्रो भविष्यति ॥ 27 ॥
4.93.m:
Having conferred a blessing upon the bamboo, they then spoke to the offering of the goddess:
“Take the semen of the auspicious one; you shall have a son!”

4.93.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadāgnirnaṣṭo devānāṃ kenāgnitvaṃ tadā kṛtam ..
bhūyo'pi kena kālena agniragnitvamāptavān .. 28 ..
4.93.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यदाग्निर्नष्टो देवानां केनाग्नित्वं तदा कृतम् ॥
भूयोऽपि केन कालेन अग्निरग्नित्वमाप्तवान् ॥ 28 ॥
4.93.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
When Agni was lost to the gods, by whom was the function of fire then performed?
And after what time did Agni once again regain the nature of fire?

4.93.s:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpranaṣṭe'gnau yenāgnitvaṃ kadācana ..
yasminkāle tithī yasyā punaragnitvamāptavān .. 29 ..
4.93.d:
॥ कृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्प्रनष्टेऽग्नौ येनाग्नित्वं कदाचन ॥
यस्मिन्काले तिथी यस्या पुनरग्नित्वमाप्तवान् ॥ 29 ॥
4.93.m:
Kṛṣṇa said:
Hear, O king, by whom the function of fire was once [performed] when Agni was lost,
and at what time and on what lunar day he regained the nature of fire.

4.93.s:
utathyāṅgirasoḥ pūrvamāsīdvyatikaro mahān ..
ahaṃ vidyātapobhyāṃ vai tava jyāyāñchrutena ca ..
utathyenaivamuktastu aṅgirāḥ prāha taṃ munim ..4.93.30..
4.93.d:
उतथ्याङ्गिरसोः पूर्वमासीद्व्यतिकरो महान् ॥
अहं विद्यातपोभ्यां वै तव ज्यायाञ्छ्रुतेन च ॥
उतथ्येनैवमुक्तस्तु अङ्गिराः प्राह तं मुनिम् ॥4.93.30॥
4.93.m:
Formerly there was a great dispute between Utathya and Aṅgiras:
“I am indeed superior to you in learning, asceticism, and sacred knowledge!”
Having been addressed thus by Utathya, Aṅgiras said to that sage:

4.93.s:
gacchāvo brahmasadanaṃ marīcipramukhairdvijaiḥ ..
upetaṃ cānyamunibhirbrahmarājarṣisattamaiḥ ..
utathyaḥ prāha sadbrahmanṛṣīṃstānstabdhamānasaḥ .. 31 ..
4.93.d:
गच्छावो ब्रह्मसदनं मरीचिप्रमुखैर्द्विजैः ॥
उपेतं चान्यमुनिभिर्ब्रह्मराजर्षिसत्तमैः ॥
उतथ्यः प्राह सद्ब्रह्मनृषींस्तान्स्तब्धमानसः ॥ 31 ॥
4.93.m: “Let the two of us go to the abode of Brahmā, attended by twice-born led by Marīci / and by other sages, the best of Brahmanical and royal sages.” / Utathya, his mind haughty, spoke to the true Brahmā and those sages:

4.93.s: jyāyānvā katamosmākamiti naḥ kathyatāṃ sphuṭam .. 32 ..
4.93.d: ज्यायान्वा कतमोस्माकमिति नः कथ्यतां स्फुटम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.93.m: “Which of us two is superior? Let this be told to us clearly!”

4.93.s:
athovāca munirbrahmā tāvubhau kuddhamānasau ..
ānayadhvaṃ drutaṃ gatvā vibudhānbhuvaneśvarān ..33..
4.93.d:
अथोवाच मुनिर्ब्रह्मा तावुभौ कुद्धमानसौ ॥
आनयध्वं द्रुतं गत्वा विबुधान्भुवनेश्वरान् ॥33॥
4.93.m:
Then Brahmā said to those two sages whose minds were enraged:
“Go quickly and bring the gods, the lords of the world;

4.93.s:
tato vivādaṃ paśyāmi bhavatāṃ taiḥ sametya ca ..
tatastau sahitau natvā''ninyatuśca ṛṣīṃstadā ..34..
4.93.d:
ततो विवादं पश्यामि भवतां तैः समेत्य च ॥
ततस्तौ सहितौ नत्वा'ऽनिन्यतुश्च ऋषींस्तदा ॥34॥
4.93.m:
then, having assembled with them, I shall examine your dispute.”
Then the two together bowed and brought the sages then,

4.93.s:
lokapālānmaheṃdrādīnsayamānvāruṇānilān..
sādhyānmarudgaṇānviṣvānṛṣīnbhṛgvagnināradān .. .. 35..
4.93.d:
लोकपालान्महेंद्रादीन्सयमान्वारुणानिलान्॥
साध्यान्मरुद्गणान्विष्वानृषीन्भृग्वग्निनारदान् ॥ ॥ 35॥
4.93.m:
the world protectors led by Mahendra, together with Yama, Varuṇa, and Vāyu,
the Sādhyas, the hosts of Maruts, the Viśvedevas, the sages Bhṛgu, Agni, and Nārada,

4.93.s:
gaṃdharvānvittarakṣoghnānrākṣasāndaityadānavān ..
nāyātastatra tigmāṃśuḥ sarve cānye samāgatāḥ .. 36 ..
4.93.d:
गंधर्वान्वित्तरक्षोघ्नान्राक्षसान्दैत्यदानवान् ॥
नायातस्तत्र तिग्मांशुः सर्वे चान्ये समागताः ॥ 36 ॥
4.93.m:
the Gandharvas, the slayers of Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, the Rākṣasas, the Daityas, and the Dānavas.
The hot-rayed [Sun] did not arrive there, but all the others assembled.

4.93.s:
dṛṣṭvā tu vibudhānsarvānbrahmā provāca tānṛṣīn ..
ānayadhvamitaḥ sūryaṃ sāmnā daṃḍena vā punaḥ .. 37 ..
4.93.d:
दृष्ट्वा तु विबुधान्सर्वान्ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तानृषीन् ॥
आनयध्वमितः सूर्यं साम्ना दंडेन वा पुनः ॥ 37 ॥
4.93.m: Seeing all the gods, Brahmā said to those sages: / 'Bring Sūrya here, either by conciliation or by force.'

4.93.s:
evamukto gatastāvadutathyaḥ sūryamaṃḍalam ..
sa gatvā prāha mārtaṇḍaṃ śīghramehyeva saṃvidam .. 38 ..
4.93.d:
एवमुक्तो गतस्तावदुतथ्यः सूर्यमंडलम् ॥
स गत्वा प्राह मार्तण्डं शीघ्रमेह्येव संविदम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.93.m: Having been spoken to thus, Utathya went at once to the orb of the sun. / Going there, he said to Mārtaṇḍa, 'Come quickly to the assembly!'

4.93.s:
sa utathyamathovāca kathaṃ brahmanvrajāmyaham ..
evamuktvā gataḥ sūryo bhuvane mayi nirgate .. 39 ..
4.93.d:
स उतथ्यमथोवाच कथं ब्रह्मन्व्रजाम्यहम् ॥
एवमुक्त्वा गतः सूर्यो भुवने मयि निर्गते ॥ 39 ॥
4.93.m: He then said to Utathya, 'O brāhmaṇa, how can I go? / If I depart, the world [will perish].' Having spoken thus, Sūrya departed [with him].

4.93.s:
evamukto muniḥ prāyātsarva devasamāgamam ..
ācacakṣe ca yatproktaṃ bhāsvatā tapanaṃ prati .. 4.93.40 ..
4.93.d:
एवमुक्तो मुनिः प्रायात्सर्व देवसमागमम् ॥
आचचक्षे च यत्प्रोक्तं भास्वता तपनं प्रति ॥ 4.93.40 ॥
4.93.m: Addressed in this way, the sage went to the assembly of all the gods / and reported what had been said by the sun concerning his blazing heat.

4.93.s:
uvācāṅgirasaṃ brahmā śīghramenaṃ tvamānaya ..
sa tathokto gatastatra yatrāsau tapate raviḥ .. 41 ..
4.93.d:
उवाचाङ्गिरसं ब्रह्मा शीघ्रमेनं त्वमानय ॥
स तथोक्तो गतस्तत्र यत्रासौ तपते रविः ॥ 41 ॥
4.93.m: Brahmā said to Aṅgiras, 'Bring him quickly yourself.' / Having been spoken to thus, he went to where the sun was shining.

4.93.s:
ehyehi bhagavansūrya tapyate bhavatānvaham ..
evamukto gataḥ sūryo yatra devāḥ samāgatāḥ .. 42 ..
4.93.d:
एह्येहि भगवन्सूर्य तप्यते भवतान्वहम् ॥
एवमुक्तो गतः सूर्यो यत्र देवाः समागताः ॥ 42 ॥
4.93.m: 'Come, come, Lord Sūrya! [The world] is scorched by you every day.' / Having been spoken to thus, Sūrya went to where the gods had gathered.

4.93.s:
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ provāca kiṃ vā kāryamupasthitam ..
pṛcchantameva mārtaṃrḍaṃ brahmā provāca sādaram .. 43 ..
4.93.d:
स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं प्रोवाच किं वा कार्यमुपस्थितम् ॥
पृच्छन्तमेव मार्तंर्डं ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच सादरम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.93.m: Standing for a moment, he said, 'What business has arisen?' / To Mārtaṇḍa who was thus asking, Brahmā respectfully replied:

4.93.s:
gaccha śīghraṃ na dahate bhuvanaṃ yāvadaṃgirāḥ ..
labdhaprāyaṃ tu golokaṃ vartate kṛṣṇapiṃgalam .. 44 ..
4.93.d:
गच्छ शीघ्रं न दहते भुवनं यावदंगिराः ॥
लब्धप्रायं तु गोलोकं वर्तते कृष्णपिंगलम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.93.m: 'Go quickly, before Aṅgiras burns up the world! / The realm of cows is almost captured, turning black and dark brown.

4.93.s:
pāṭalo haritaḥ śoṇaḥ śveto varṇaḥ praṇāśitaḥ ..
śākadvīpaṃ kuśadvīpaṃ krauñcadvīpaṃ sapannagam ..
dagdhamaṅgirasā sarvaṃ bhūyo'pi pradahiṣyati ..45..
4.93.d:
पाटलो हरितः शोणः श्वेतो वर्णः प्रणाशितः ॥
शाकद्वीपं कुशद्वीपं क्रौञ्चद्वीपं सपन्नगम् ॥
दग्धमङ्गिरसा सर्वं भूयोऽपि प्रदहिष्यति ॥45॥
4.93.m: The pale red, green, crimson, and white colors have been destroyed. / Śākadvīpa, Kuśadvīpa, and Krauñcadvīpa along with their serpents / have all been burned by Aṅgiras, and he will burn them again.

4.93.s:
yāvacca dahate sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ tapasāṃgirāḥ ..
gaccha tāvaditaḥ śīghraṃ svasthāne tapa bhāskara .. 46 ..
4.93.d:
यावच्च दहते सर्वं भुवनं तपसांगिराः ॥
गच्छ तावदितः शीघ्रं स्वस्थाने तप भास्कर ॥ 46 ॥
4.93.m: Before Aṅgiras burns the entire world with his ascetic power, / go quickly from here, O Bhāskara, and shine in your own place!'

4.93.s:
evamuktaḥ sa vibhunā svasthānamadhirūḍhavān ..
visṛṣṭavānaṃgirasaṃ sakāśamamṛtāśinām .. 47 ..
4.93.d:
एवमुक्तः स विभुना स्वस्थानमधिरूढवान् ॥
विसृष्टवानंगिरसं सकाशममृताशिनाम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.93.m: Spoken to thus by the Lord, he ascended to his own place. / [Brahmā] sent Aṅgiras to the presence of the gods.

4.93.s:
gatvāṅgirā uvācedaṃ gataḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham ..
devā aṃgirasaṃ prāhustaporāśimakalmaṣam .. 48 ..
4.93.d:
गत्वाङ्गिरा उवाचेदं गतः किं करवाण्यहम् ॥
देवा अंगिरसं प्राहुस्तपोराशिमकल्मषम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.93.m: Going there, Aṅgiras spoke these words: 'He has gone. What shall I do?' / The gods spoke to Aṅgiras, that stainless mass of ascetic heat.

4.93.s:
saṃpraśasyocuragnitvaṃ kuru tāvanmahītale ..
pūrvaṃ yathāgniḥ kṛtavāṃstathā tvamapi sattama .. 49 ..
4.93.d:
संप्रशस्योचुरग्नित्वं कुरु तावन्महीतले ॥
पूर्वं यथाग्निः कृतवांस्तथा त्वमपि सत्तम ॥ 49 ॥
4.93.m: Praising him, they said: 'Perform the office of Fire on the surface of the earth for now. / As Fire did formerly, so do you also, O best of virtuous beings,

4.93.s:
yāvadagniṃ prapaśyāmaḥ kvāsau naṣṭaḥ kva tiṣṭhati ..
evamuktaḥ sa devaistu agnitvaṃ kṛtavāṃstadā .. 4.93.50 ..
4.93.d:
यावदग्निं प्रपश्यामः क्वासौ नष्टः क्व तिष्ठति ॥
एवमुक्तः स देवैस्तु अग्नित्वं कृतवांस्तदा ॥ 4.93.50 ॥
4.93.m: until we find Fire, [to see] where he has perished and where he stays.' / Spoken to thus by the gods, he then performed the office of Fire.

4.93.s:
devairdṛṣṭo yathā hyagnistatte sarvaṃ niveditam ..
devakārye kṛte tasmindevā vahni mathābruvan .. 51 ..
4.93.d:
देवैर्दृष्टो यथा ह्यग्निस्तत्ते सर्वं निवेदितम् ॥
देवकार्ये कृते तस्मिन्देवा वह्नि मथाब्रुवन् ॥ 51 ॥
4.93.m: How Fire was indeed seen by the gods has all been related to you. / When that work of the gods was accomplished, the gods then spoke to Fire:

4.93.s:
agne'gnitvaṃ kuruṣva tvamaṃgirāstu yathā purā ..
evamuktaḥ surairvahniścintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ .. 52 ..
4.93.d:
अग्नेऽग्नित्वं कुरुष्व त्वमंगिरास्तु यथा पुरा ॥
एवमुक्तः सुरैर्वह्निश्चिन्तयामास दुःखितः ॥ 52 ॥
4.93.m: 'O Fire, perform the office of Fire yourself, as Aṅgiras [did] previously.' / Addressed in this way by the gods, Fire reflected in sorrow:

4.93.s:
ko me'pahṛtaṃ tejaḥ kenāgnitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tviha ..
dṛṣṭvāthāgniraṅgirasaṃ tejorāśimakalmaṣam .. 53 ..
4.93.d:
को मेऽपहृतं तेजः केनाग्नित्वं कृतं त्विह ॥
दृष्ट्वाथाग्निरङ्गिरसं तेजोराशिमकल्मषम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.93.m: 'Who has stolen my fiery energy? Who has performed the office of Fire here?' / Then, seeing Aṅgiras, a stainless heap of fiery energy,

4.93.s:
uvāca muñca matsthānaṃ vacastoṣakaraṃ śṛṇu ..
ahaṃ te tanayaśceṣṭo bhaviṣye prathame śubhe .. 54 ..
4.93.d:
उवाच मुञ्च मत्स्थानं वचस्तोषकरं शृणु ॥
अहं ते तनयश्चेष्टो भविष्ये प्रथमे शुभे ॥ 54 ॥
4.93.m: he said: 'Relinquish my place; hear words that will bring you joy. / I shall become your favorite son in the first auspicious [birth],

4.93.s:
bṛhaspatīti nāmā vai tathānye bahavaḥ sutāḥ ..
evamukto munistuṣṭo bahūṃścājanayatsutān .. 55 ..
4.93.d:
बृहस्पतीति नामा वै तथान्ये बहवः सुताः ॥
एवमुक्तो मुनिस्तुष्टो बहूंश्चाजनयत्सुतान् ॥ 55 ॥
4.93.m: named Bṛhaspati, and likewise there will be many other sons.' / Spoken to thus, the sage was pleased and engendered many sons.

4.93.s:
vahniṃ saṃjanayāmāsa putrānpautrāṃstadāṃgirāḥ ..
avāpa punaragnitvamagnistasyāṃ tithau nṛpa .. 56 ..
4.93.d:
वह्निं संजनयामास पुत्रान्पौत्रांस्तदांगिराः ॥
अवाप पुनरग्नित्वमग्निस्तस्यां तिथौ नृप ॥ 56 ॥
4.93.m: Aṅgiras then fathered Fire, [as well as] sons and grandsons. / Fire attained the state of fire again on that lunar day, O king.

4.93.s:
sarvameva caturdaśyāṃ saṃjātaṃ havyavāhanam ..
havyavāhana devānāṃ bhūtānāṃ guhyacāritam .. 57 ..
4.93.d:
सर्वमेव चतुर्दश्यां संजातं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
हव्यवाहन देवानां भूतानां गुह्यचारितम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.93.m: On the fourteenth [lunar day], the bearer of oblations was completely produced— / the bearer of oblations for the gods and for the secret-moving beings.

4.93.s:
tato'ṣṭapatipatve ca rudreṇa pratipāditam ..
pūjiteyaṃ tithirdevairdivisthaiśca nṛpairapi .. 58 ..
4.93.d:
ततोऽष्टपतिपत्वे च रुद्रेण प्रतिपादितम् ॥
पूजितेयं तिथिर्देवैर्दिविस्थैश्च नृपैरपि ॥ 58 ॥
4.93.m: Then, [his] lordship over the eight masters was established by Rudra. / This lunar day was worshipped by the gods dwelling in heaven and also by kings,

4.93.s:
pailajābālimanvādyairanyaiśca nahuṣādibhiḥ ..
viṣaśastrahatānāṃ ca saṃgrāmenyatra te kvacit .. 59 ..
4.93.d:
पैलजाबालिमन्वाद्यैरन्यैश्च नहुषादिभिः ॥
विषशस्त्रहतानां च संग्रामेन्यत्र ते क्वचित् ॥ 59 ॥
4.93.m: by Paila, Jābāli, Manu, and others, and by others such as Nahuṣa; / and for those killed by poison or weapons, in battle or elsewhere,

4.93.s:
ajñātāvṛṣapāpaiśca vyālairye vyāpya hiṃsitāḥ ..
nadīpravāha patitaḥ samudre parvate'dhvani .. 4.93.60 ..
4.93.d:
अज्ञातावृषपापैश्च व्यालैर्ये व्याप्य हिंसिताः ॥
नदीप्रवाह पतितः समुद्रे पर्वतेऽध्वनि ॥ 4.93.60 ॥
4.93.m: and those who, being overcome, were slain by unrecognised sins or by beasts of prey, / or who fell into the current of a river, into the ocean, onto a mountain, or on the road,

4.93.s:
patitāḥ parvatebhyaśca toyāgnidahane mṛtāḥ ..
udadhyā pātitā ye ca ye ke cātmahano janāḥ ..
teṣāṃ śastaṃ caturdaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ svargasukhapradam ..61 ..
4.93.d:
पतिताः पर्वतेभ्यश्च तोयाग्निदहने मृताः ॥
उदध्या पातिता ये च ये के चात्महनो जनाः ॥
तेषां शस्तं चतुर्दश्यां श्राद्धं स्वर्गसुखप्रदम् ॥61 ॥
4.93.m: or who fell from mountains, or died by water or burning in fire, / or were thrown into the ocean, or whatever persons commit suicide— / for them, an ancestral offering on the fourteenth [lunar day] is commended as bestowing the bliss of heaven.

4.93.s:
śrāddhāni caiva dattāni dānāni sulaghūnyapi ..
prasūnaphalabhojyāni upatiṣṭhaṃti tānnarān .. 62 ..
4.93.d:
श्राद्धानि चैव दत्तानि दानानि सुलघून्यपि ॥
प्रसूनफलभोज्यानि उपतिष्ठंति तान्नरान् ॥ 62 ॥
4.93.m: And ancestral offerings offered [then], as well as gifts, even very small ones, / consisting of flowers, fruits, and food, attend upon those men.

4.93.s:
evaṃ tithiriyaṃ rājannāgneyī procyate janaiḥ ..
raudrīṃ ca kecidityāhū rudrogniḥ sa ca paṭhyate .. 63 ..
4.93.d:
एवं तिथिरियं राजन्नाग्नेयी प्रोच्यते जनैः ॥
रौद्रीं च केचिदित्याहू रुद्रोग्निः स च पठ्यते ॥ 63 ॥
4.93.m: Thus, O king, this lunar day is declared by people to belong to Agni. / Some also call it Raudrī, for Rudra is recited to be Agni.

4.93.s:
yasyāṃ manorathaṃ yaṃyaṃ samuddiśya hyupoṣati ..
dadāti tasya tadvahniḥ sāgre saṃvatsare gate .. 64 ..
4.93.d:
यस्यां मनोरथं यंयं समुद्दिश्य ह्युपोषति ॥
ददाति तस्य तद्वह्निः साग्रे संवत्सरे गते ॥ 64 ॥
4.93.m: Whatever wish one fasts for with dedication on it, / Fire grants him that when a full year has passed.

4.93.s:
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya trilocanam ..
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyai rātrau jāgaraṇānnaraḥ ..
pañcagavyaṃ niśi prāśya svapyādbhūmau vimatsaraḥ .. 65 ..
4.93.d:
चतुर्दश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य त्रिलोचनम् ॥
पुष्पधूपादिनैवेद्यै रात्रौ जागरणान्नरः ॥
पञ्चगव्यं निशि प्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमौ विमत्सरः ॥ 65 ॥
4.93.m: A man who abstains from food on the fourteenth, having worshipped the three-eyed god / with flowers, incense, food offerings, and so on, keeping vigil at night, / consuming the five products of the cow at night, should sleep on the ground, free from malice,

4.93.s:
śyāmākamatha vā bhuktvā tailakṣāravivarjitam ..
homaḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaḥ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ nṛpa .. .. 66 ..
4.93.d:
श्यामाकमथ वा भुक्त्वा तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥
होमः कृष्णतिलैः कार्यः शतमष्टोत्तरं नृप ॥ ॥ 66 ॥
4.93.m: or having eaten śyāmāka grain free of oil and salt. / A fire sacrifice with black sesame seeds should be performed one hundred and eight times, O king,

4.93.s:
agnaye havyavāhanāya somāyāṃgirase namaḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale snāpya paṃcāmṛtaiḥ śivam .. 67 ..
4.93.d:
अग्नये हव्यवाहनाय सोमायांगिरसे नमः ॥
ततः प्रभाते विमले स्नाप्य पंचामृतैः शिवम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.93.m: [saying:] 'Homage to Agni, the bearer of oblations; to Soma; to Aṅgiras!' / Then, at clear dawn, having bathed Śiva with the five nectars,

4.93.s:
pūjayitvā vidhānena homaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva ca ..
udīrayenmantrametaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāṃjalim .. 68 ..
4.93.d:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन होमं कृत्वा तथैव च ॥
उदीरयेन्मन्त्रमेतं कृत्वा शिरसि चांजलिम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.93.m: having worshipped according to the rite, and likewise having performed the fire sacrifice, / he should utter this mantra, placing his folded hands on his head:

4.93.s:
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ sūryāgnirūpiṇe ..
putrānyaccha sukhaṃ yaccha mokṣaṃ yaccha namo'stu te .. 69 ..
4.93.d:
नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं नमः सूर्याग्निरूपिणे ॥
पुत्रान्यच्छ सुखं यच्छ मोक्षं यच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 69 ॥
4.93.m: 'Homage to you who possess the three forms! Homage to you who have the form of Sūrya and Agni! / Grant sons, grant happiness, grant liberation! Homage be to you!'

4.93.s:
nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ..
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathoditam .. 4.93.70 ..
4.93.d:
नीराजनं ततः कृत्वा पश्चाद्भुंजीत वाग्यतः ॥
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते कृत्वा सर्वं यथोदितम् ॥ 4.93.70 ॥
4.93.m: Then, having performed the wave-offering of lamps, he should eat afterwards, restraining his speech. / Having performed all as described at the end of a year,

4.93.s:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam ..
vṛṣaskaṃdhagataṃ saumyaṃ sitavastrayugānvitam .. 71 ..
4.93.d:
सौवर्णं कारयेद्देवं त्रिनेत्रं शूलपाणिनम् ॥
वृषस्कंधगतं सौम्यं सितवस्त्रयुगान्वितम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.93.m: he should have a golden deity made, three-eyed, holding a trident in hand, / seated on the shoulders of a bull, gentle, provided with a pair of white garments,

4.93.s:
candanenānuliptāṅgaṃ sitamālyopaśobhitam ..
sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
sarvakālikametatte kathitaṃ vratamuttamam .. 72 ..
4.93.d:
चन्दनेनानुलिप्ताङ्गं सितमाल्योपशोभितम् ॥
स्थापयित्वा ताम्रपात्रे ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
सर्वकालिकमेतत्ते कथितं व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.93.m: his limbs anointed with sandalwood paste, adorned with white garlands. / Placing it in a copper vessel, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa. / This excellent votive observance, suitable for all times, has been told to you.

4.93.s:
saṃvatsaraṃ samāptaṃ hi vratasya tu yadā bhavet ..
kāle gate bahutithe tīrthasya śaraṇaṃ bhavet ..
mṛtasya deho divyastho divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ..73..
4.93.d:
संवत्सरं समाप्तं हि व्रतस्य तु यदा भवेत् ॥
काले गते बहुतिथे तीर्थस्य शरणं भवेत् ॥
मृतस्य देहो दिव्यस्थो दिव्यालंकारभूषितः ॥73॥
4.93.m: When a year of the votive observance has been completed, / after a long time has passed, he will find refuge in a sacred bathing-place; / when he dies, his body, situated in heaven, will be adorned with celestial ornaments;

4.93.s:
divyanārīgaṇavṛto vimānavaramāsthitaḥ..
devadaivaiḥ samaḥ śaṃbhoḥ krīḍati tripure ciram .. .. 74 ..
4.93.d:
दिव्यनारीगणवृतो विमानवरमास्थितः॥
देवदैवैः समः शंभोः क्रीडति त्रिपुरे चिरम् ॥ ॥ 74 ॥
4.93.m: surrounded by a host of celestial women, mounted on an excellent celestial chariot, / equal to the gods of gods, he sports for a long time in Śambhu's Tripura.

4.93.s:
iha cāgatya kālāṃte jātaḥ sa ca nṛpo bhavet ..
dātā yajvā dhanī dakṣo brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇapriyaḥ .. 75 ..
4.93.d:
इह चागत्य कालांते जातः स च नृपो भवेत् ॥
दाता यज्वा धनी दक्षो ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणप्रियः ॥ 75 ॥
4.93.m: And coming here at the end of that time, having been born, he becomes a king, / generous, a sacrificer, wealthy, capable, a brāhmaṇa, fond of brāhmaṇas,

4.93.s:
śrīmānvāgmī kṛtī dhīmānputrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
patnīgaṇasamrāyuktaściraṃ bhadrāṇi paśyati .. 76..
4.93.d:
श्रीमान्वाग्मी कृती धीमान्पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥
पत्नीगणसम्रायुक्तश्चिरं भद्राणि पश्यति ॥ 76॥
4.93.m: prosperous, eloquent, successful, wise, endowed with sons and grandsons, / accompanied by a troop of wives, he witnesses auspicious fortunes for a long time.

4.93.s:
ye durllabhā bhuvi suroragamānavānāṃ kāmā hyanuttamaguṇena yutāḥ sadaiva ..
tānā pnuvaṃti sitabhūtatithau sureśaṃ saṃpūjya somatilakaṃ vidhivanmanuṣyāḥ .. 77 ..
4.93.d:
ये दुर्ल्लभा भुवि सुरोरगमानवानां कामा ह्यनुत्तमगुणेन युताः सदैव ॥
ताना प्नुवंति सितभूततिथौ सुरेशं संपूज्य सोमतिलकं विधिवन्मनुष्याः ॥ 77 ॥
4.93.m: Those desires of gods, serpents, and mortals that are hard to obtain on earth, and always endowed with unexcelled virtue— / humans obtain them by worshipping according to the rite the Lord of Gods, who is adorned with the moon, on the bright fourteenth lunar day.

4.94.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anaṃtavratamastyanyatsarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva yudhiṣṭhira .. 1 ..
4.94.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अनंतव्रतमस्त्यन्यत्सर्वपापहरं शिवम् ॥
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां स्त्रीणां चैव युधिष्ठिर ॥ 1 ॥
4.94.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / "There is another observance, the Ananta votive observance, which removes all sins, brings auspiciousness, / and bestows all desires upon men and women, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.94.s:
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade śubhe ..
tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 2 ..
4.94.d:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां मासि भाद्रपदे शुभे ॥
तस्यानुष्ठानमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 2 ॥
4.94.m: On the fourteenth [lunar day] of the bright fortnight in the auspicious month of Bhādrapada, / by merely performing it, one is released from all sins."

4.94.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇa ko'yaṃ tvayākhyāto hyanaṃta iti viśrutaḥ ..
kiṃ śeṣanāga āhosvidanaṃtastakṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 3 ..
4.94.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्ण कोऽयं त्वयाख्यातो ह्यनंत इति विश्रुतः ॥
किं शेषनाग आहोस्विदनंतस्तक्षकः स्मृतः ॥ 3 ॥
4.94.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "O Kṛṣṇa, who is this one whom you call Ananta, who is renowned thus? / Is he the serpent Śeṣa, or is Ananta considered to be Takṣaka?

4.94.s:
paramātmātha vānaṃta utāho brahma ucyate ..
ka eṣo'naṃtasaṃjño vai tathyaṃ brūhi keśava .. 4 ..
4.94.d:
परमात्माथ वानंत उताहो ब्रह्म उच्यते ॥
क एषोऽनंतसंज्ञो वै तथ्यं ब्रूहि केशव ॥ 4 ॥
4.94.m: Or is Ananta the Supreme Self, or is Brahman spoken of [as Ananta]? / Who is this being named Ananta? Tell me the truth, O Keśava."

4.94.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anaṃta ityahaṃ pārtha mama nāma nibodhaya ..
ādityādiṣu vāreṣu yaḥ kāla upapadyate .. 5 ..
4.94.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अनंत इत्यहं पार्थ मम नाम निबोधय ॥
आदित्यादिषु वारेषु यः काल उपपद्यते ॥ 5 ॥
4.94.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / "O son of Pṛthā, know that my name is Ananta. / The time that occurs in the days of the sun and the rest,

4.94.s:
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtādi dinarātriśarīravān ..
pakṣamāsartuvarṣādi yugakalpavyavasthayā .. 6 ..
4.94.d:
कलाकाष्ठामुहूर्तादि दिनरात्रिशरीरवान् ॥
पक्षमासर्तुवर्षादि युगकल्पव्यवस्थया ॥ 6 ॥
4.94.m: having day and night for its body, divided into kalās, kāṣṭhās, muhūrtas, and the like, / according to the system of fortnights, months, seasons, years, yugas, and kalpas—

4.94.s:
yo'yaṃ kālo mayākhyātastava dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ..
so'haṃ kālo'vatīrṇo'tra bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt .. 7 ..
4.94.d:
योऽयं कालो मयाख्यातस्तव धर्मभृतां वर ॥
सोऽहं कालोऽवतीर्णोऽत्र भुवो भारावतारणात् ॥ 7 ॥
4.94.m: this time which has been described by me to you, O best of the upholders of righteousness, / is I myself, time, who have descended here in order to remove the burden of the earth,

4.94.s:
dānavānāṃ vināśāya vasudevakulodbhavam ..
