karavīraiśca rājendra tathā pūjyo maheśvaraḥ .. 21 ..
4.97.d:
अर्कपुष्पैः कदंबैश्च शतपत्रैस्तथोत्पलैः ॥
करवीरैश्च राजेन्द्र तथा पूज्यो महेश्वरः ॥ 21 ॥
4.97.m: with arka flowers and kadambas, with lotuses and blue water-lilies, / and with karavīras, O best of kings, Maheśvara is thus to be worshipped.

4.97.s:
ekaikena caturdaśyāmarcayetpārvatīpatim ..
punaśca kārttike māsi saṃprāpte tarpayeddvijān .. 22 ..
4.97.d:
एकैकेन चतुर्दश्यामर्चयेत्पार्वतीपतिम् ॥
पुनश्च कार्त्तिके मासि संप्राप्ते तर्पयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 22 ॥
4.97.m: With each single one [in turn], he should worship Pārvatī's husband on the fourteenth day. / And once more, when the month of Kārttika has arrived, he should gratify the twice-born.

4.97.s:
annairnānāvidhairbhakṣyairvastrairmālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
kṛtvā nīlaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ śrutyuktavidhinā naraḥ..23..
4.97.d:
अन्नैर्नानाविधैर्भक्ष्यैर्वस्त्रैर्माल्यविभूषणैः ॥
कृत्वा नीलं वृषोत्सर्गं श्रुत्युक्तविधिना नरः॥23॥
4.97.m: With various kinds of foods, edibles, garments, garlands, and ornaments, / having performed the release of a dark bull according to the rule declared in the Vedic texts, a man

4.97.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha..
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtam..24..
4.97.d:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं वृषभं च गवा सह॥
मुक्ताफलाष्टकयुतं सितनेत्रपटावृतम्॥24॥
4.97.m: should present golden images of Umā and Maheśvara and a bull together with a cow, / endowed with eight pearls, covered with a white silk cloth,

4.97.s:
sarvopaskarayuktāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ vinivedayet..
udakuṃbhayutaṃ tadvacchālitaṃdulasaṃyutam..25..
4.97.d:
सर्वोपस्करयुक्तायां शय्यायां विनिवेदयेत्॥
उदकुंभयुतं तद्वच्छालितंदुलसंयुतम्॥25॥
4.97.m: upon a bed equipped with all furnishings, / likewise accompanied by a water-pot and provided with śāli-rice.

4.97.s:
sthāpya viprāya śāṃtāya vedavrataparāya ca..
jyeṣṭhasāmavide deyaṃ na ca kurvaṃti te kvacit..26..
4.97.d:
स्थाप्य विप्राय शांताय वेदव्रतपराय च॥
ज्येष्ठसामविदे देयं न च कुर्वंति ते क्वचित्॥26॥
4.97.m: Having placed [it], it should be given to a peaceful vipra devoted to Vedic vows / who knows the Jyeṣṭhasāman; and such [gifts] are not given by them just anywhere.

4.97.s:
avyaṃgāya ca saumyāya sadākalyāṇakāriṇe ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta kurvaṃllobhātpatatyadhaḥ .. 27 ..
4.97.d:
अव्यंगाय च सौम्याय सदाकल्याणकारिणे ॥
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ॥
न वित्तशाठ्यं कुर्वीत कुर्वंल्लोभात्पतत्यधः ॥ 27 ॥
4.97.m: Having worshipped him along with his wife—one devoid of defects, gentle, and always bringing auspiciousness— / with garlands, garments, and ornaments, he should not practice deceit regarding his wealth; doing so out of greed, he falls downward.

4.97.s:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryācchivacaturdaśīm ..
so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 28 ..
4.97.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्याच्छिवचतुर्दशीम् ॥
सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 28 ॥
4.97.m: Whosoever performs the Śivacaturdaśī according to this rule, / that person obtains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.

4.97.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yadatrāmutra vā kṛtam..
pitṛbhirmātṛbhirvāpi tatsarvaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
4.97.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं यदत्रामुत्र वा कृतम्॥
पितृभिर्मातृभिर्वापि तत्सर्वं नाशमाप्नुयात् ॥ 29 ॥
4.97.m: Whatever sin, such as killing a brāhmaṇa, was committed in this world or the next / by his fathers or by his mothers, all of that meets destruction.

4.97.s:
dīrghāyurārogyakulābhivṛddhiratrākṣayānyatra caturbhujatvam ..
gaṇādhipatyaṃ divi kalpakoṭī svarge uṣitvā padameti śaṃbhoḥ .. 4.97.30 ..
4.97.d:
दीर्घायुरारोग्यकुलाभिवृद्धिरत्राक्षयान्यत्र चतुर्भुजत्वम् ॥
गणाधिपत्यं दिवि कल्पकोटी स्वर्गे उषित्वा पदमेति शंभोः ॥ 4.97.30 ॥
4.97.m: Long life, good health, increase of lineage [are gained] here, imperishable [merit] elsewhere, and the state of having four arms; / lordship over the gaṇas in heaven; having dwelt in heaven for tens of millions of kalpas, he attains the abode of Śambhu.

4.97.s:
na bṛhaspatirapyatmannarasya phalamiṃdro na pitāmaho'pi vaktum ..
na ca siddhaguṇora'pyalaṃ na vāhaṃ yadi jihvāyutakoṭyapīha vaktre .. 31 ..
4.97.d:
न बृहस्पतिरप्यत्मन्नरस्य फलमिंद्रो न पितामहोऽपि वक्तुम् ॥
न च सिद्धगुणोरऽप्यलं न वाहं यदि जिह्वायुतकोट्यपीह वक्त्रे ॥ 31 ॥
4.97.m: Even Bṛhaspati cannot declare the fruit of such a man, nor Indra, nor the Grandfather, / nor are the Siddhas capable, nor am I, even if there were tens of millions of myriad tongues in the mouth.

4.97.s:
bhavatyamaravallabhaḥ paṭhati yaḥ smaredvā sadā śṛṇotyapi vimatsaraḥ sakalapāpanirmocanīm ..
imāṃ śivacaturdaśīmamarakāminīkoṭayaḥ stuvaṃti divi naṃditā kimu samācaredyaḥ sadā .. 32 ..
4.97.d:
भवत्यमरवल्लभः पठति यः स्मरेद्वा सदा शृणोत्यपि विमत्सरः सकलपापनिर्मोचनीम् ॥
इमां शिवचतुर्दशीममरकामिनीकोटयः स्तुवंति दिवि नंदिता किमु समाचरेद्यः सदा ॥ 32 ॥
4.97.m: He becomes dear to the gods who, free from jealousy, reads, remembers, or constantly hears / this Śivacaturdaśī which releases from all sins; millions of celestial women praise him in heaven, delighted; what more for one who observes it constantly?

4.97.s:
yā pārtha nārī kurute'tibhaktyā bharttāramāpṛcchya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā ..
sāpi prasādātparameśvarasya paraṃ padaṃ yāti pinākapāṇeḥ .. 33 ..
phalatyāgacaturdaśīvratavarṇanam
4.97.d:
या पार्थ नारी कुरुतेऽतिभक्त्या भर्त्तारमापृच्छ्य शुभं गुरुं वा ॥
सापि प्रसादात्परमेश्वरस्य परं पदं याति पिनाकपाणेः ॥ 33 ॥
फलत्यागचतुर्दशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.97.m:
Whatever woman, O Pārtha, performs [it] with great devotion, having asked her husband or her auspicious guru, / she also, through the grace of Parameśvara, goes to the supreme abode of the Pināka-bearer.
Description of the Votive Observance of Phalatyāgacaturdaśī

4.98.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tathā sarvaphalatyāgamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhārata ..
yadakṣayaṃ pare loke sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 1 ..
4.98.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तथा सर्वफलत्यागमाहात्म्यं शृणु भारत ॥
यदक्षयं परे लोके सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.98.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Listen likewise, O descendant of Bharata, to the greatness of the renunciation of all fruits, / which is imperishable in the next world and grants the fruit of all desires.

4.98.s:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi caturdaśyāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ ..
āraṃbhe śuklapakṣasya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam .. 2 ..
4.98.d:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि चतुर्दश्यां धृतव्रतः ॥
आरंभे शुक्लपक्षस्य कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.98.m: Having undertaken the votive observance on the fourteenth day in the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, / at the beginning of the bright fortnight, having performed the invocation of blessings from brāhmaṇas,

4.98.s:
anyeṣvapi tu māseṣu aṣṭamyāṃ narasattama ..
sadakṣiṇāpāyasena śaktitaḥ pūjayeddvijān..3..
4.98.d:
अन्येष्वपि तु मासेषु अष्टम्यां नरसत्तम ॥
सदक्षिणापायसेन शक्तितः पूजयेद्द्विजान्॥3॥
4.98.m: and also on the eighth day in other months, O best of men, / he should worship the twice-born according to his means with milk-rice pudding and sacrificial fees.

4.98.s:
aṣṭādaśānāṃ dhānyānāmanyatra phalamūlakam ..
varjayedabdamekaṃ tu vidhinauṣadhakārakam .. .. 4 ..
4.98.d:
अष्टादशानां धान्यानामन्यत्र फलमूलकम् ॥
वर्जयेदब्दमेकं तु विधिनौषधकारकम् ॥ ॥ 4 ॥
4.98.m: Aside from eighteen grains, he should renounce fruit and roots, / and what is used as medicine, for one year according to the rule.

4.98.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ..
aśaktaśca vrataṃ kartuṃ sahasaiva pramucyate ..5..
4.98.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च ॥
अशक्तश्च व्रतं कर्तुं सहसैव प्रमुच्यते ॥5॥
4.98.m: Then at the end of the year, on the fourteenth and eighth days, / even one unable to perform the votive observance is immediately liberated.

4.98.s:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayedrudraṃ dharmarājaṃ tathaiva ca ..
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca vṛṃtākaṃ panasaṃ tathā ..6..
4.98.d:
सौवर्णं कारयेद्रुद्रं धर्मराजं तथैव च ॥
कूष्माण्डं मातुलुंगं च वृंताकं पनसं तथा ॥6॥
4.98.m: He should have a golden image of Rudra made, and likewise of Dharmarāja, / and [images of] ash gourd, citron, eggplant, and jackfruit,

4.98.s:
āmrāmrātakapitthaṃ ca kaliṃgaṃ servavārukam? ..
śrīphalaṃ savaṭāśvatthaṃ jaṃbīraṃ kadalīphalam ..7..
4.98.d:
आम्राम्रातकपित्थं च कलिंगं सेर्ववारुकम्? ॥
श्रीफलं सवटाश्वत्थं जंबीरं कदलीफलम् ॥7॥
4.98.m: mango, hog-plum, wood-apple, watermelon, cucumber, / bilva fruit, banyan and sacred fig, lime, plantain fruit,

4.98.s:
badaraṃ dāḍimaṃ śaktyā kāryāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa ..
mūlakāmalakaṃ jaṃbūpuṣkaraṃ karamardakam .. 8 ..
4.98.d:
बदरं दाडिमं शक्त्या कार्याण्येतानि षोडश ॥
मूलकामलकं जंबूपुष्करं करमर्दकम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.98.m: jujube, and pomegranate; according to one's means these sixteen should be made: / radish, myrobalan, rose-apple, lotus-fruit, karaunda,

4.98.s:
uduṃbaraṃ nālikeraṃ drākṣā ca bṛhatīdvayam ..
kaṃkālī kākatuṃḍīraṃ karīrakuṭajaṃ śamī .. 9 ..
4.98.d:
उदुंबरं नालिकेरं द्राक्षा च बृहतीद्वयम् ॥
कंकाली काकतुंडीरं करीरकुटजं शमी ॥ 9 ॥
4.98.m: cluster-fig, coconut, grapes, and the two bṛhatīs, / kaṅkālī, kākatuṇḍīra, karīra, kuṭaja, and śamī."

4.98.s:
raupyāṇi kārayecchaktyā phalānīmāni ṣoḍaśa ..
tāmraṃ tālaphalaṃ kuryādagastyaphalameva vā .. 4.98.10 ..
4.98.d:
रौप्याणि कारयेच्छक्त्या फलानीमानि षोडश ॥
ताम्रं तालफलं कुर्यादगस्त्यफलमेव वा ॥ 4.98.10 ॥
4.98.m: According to one's means, one should have these sixteen fruits made of silver. / One should make a palmyra fruit, or an agastya fruit, of copper,

4.98.s:
piṃḍīrakaṃ ca kharjūraṃ tathā sūraṇa kaṃdakam ..
panasaṃ lakucaṃ caiva karkaṭaṃ tiṃtiḍiṃ tathā .. 11 ..
4.98.d:
पिंडीरकं च खर्जूरं तथा सूरण कंदकम् ॥
पनसं लकुचं चैव कर्कटं तिंतिडिं तथा ॥ 11 ॥
4.98.m: as well as a piṇḍīraka, a date, and an elephant-foot yam tuber, / a jackfruit, a lakuca, a karkaṭa, and a tamarind,

4.98.s:
citrāvallīphalaṃ tadvatkūṭaśālmalikāphalam ..
madhūkaṃ kāravellaṃ ca vallīṃ gudapaṭola kam ..12..
4.98.d:
चित्रावल्लीफलं तद्वत्कूटशाल्मलिकाफलम् ॥
मधूकं कारवेल्लं च वल्लीं गुदपटोल कम् ॥12॥
4.98.m: likewise the fruit of the citrāvallī, the fruit of the kūṭaśālmalī, / a madhūka, a bitter gourd, a creeper, and a sweet paṭola.

4.98.s:
kārayecchaktito dhīmānphalānyetāni ṣoḍaśa ..
udakuṃbhadvayaṃ kuryādānyopari savāsasam ..
pakṣapātradvayopetaṃ yamarudrasamanvitam..13..
4.98.d:
कारयेच्छक्तितो धीमान्फलान्येतानि षोडश ॥
उदकुंभद्वयं कुर्यादान्योपरि सवाससम् ॥
पक्षपात्रद्वयोपेतं यमरुद्रसमन्वितम्॥13॥
4.98.m: The wise person should, according to their means, have these sixteen fruits made. / One should place two water-jars on a stand, covered with cloth, / accompanied by two cups, and dedicated to Yama and Rudra.

4.98.s:
dhenvā sahaiva śāṃtāya viprāyātha kuṭuṃbine ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇyehani nivedayet .. 14 ..
4.98.d:
धेन्वा सहैव शांताय विप्रायाथ कुटुंबिने ॥
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य पुण्येहनि निवेदयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.98.m: Then, having worshipped, one should present them together with a cow on an auspicious day / to a peaceful brahmin householder accompanied by his wife:

4.98.s:
yathā phaleṣu sarveṣu vasaṃtyamarakoṭayaḥ ..
tathā sarvaphalatyāgācchive bhaktiḥ sadāstu me .. 15 ..
4.98.d:
यथा फलेषु सर्वेषु वसंत्यमरकोटयः ॥
तथा सर्वफलत्यागाच्छिवे भक्तिः सदास्तु मे ॥ 15 ॥
4.98.m: “Just as tens of millions of immortals dwell in all fruits, / so, through the renunciation of all fruits, may there always be devotion to Śiva in me!

4.98.s:
yathā śivaśca dharmaśca sadānantaphalapradau ..
tadyuktaphaladānena tau syātāṃ me varapradau .. 16 ..
4.98.d:
यथा शिवश्च धर्मश्च सदानन्तफलप्रदौ ॥
तद्युक्तफलदानेन तौ स्यातां मे वरप्रदौ ॥ 16 ॥
4.98.m: Just as Śiva and Dharma are always the givers of endless fruit, / may they, through this gift of fruits accompanied by that [rite], be granters of boons to me!

4.98.s:
yathā phalānāṃ kāmasya śivabhaktasya sarvadā ..
yathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani .. 17 ..
4.98.d:
यथा फलानां कामस्य शिवभक्तस्य सर्वदा ॥
यथानंतफलावाप्तिरस्तु जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 17 ॥
4.98.m: Just as there is a desire for fruits, so may there always be, for a devotee of Śiva, / the attainment of endless fruit birth after birth!

4.98.s:
yathā bhedaṃ na paśyāmi śivaviṣṇvarkapadmajām ..
tathā mamāstu viśvātmā śaṅkaraḥ śaṃkaraḥ sadā .. 18 ..
4.98.d:
यथा भेदं न पश्यामि शिवविष्ण्वर्कपद्मजाम् ॥
तथा ममास्तु विश्वात्मा शङ्करः शंकरः सदा ॥ 18 ॥
4.98.m: Just as I see no difference between Śiva, Viṣṇu, the Sun, and the Lotus-born [Brahmā], / so may Śaṅkara, the Self of the universe, always be auspicious to me!”

4.98.s:
ityuccārya ca tatsarvamalaṃkṛtya vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
śaktaścecchayanaṃ dadyātsarvopaskarasaṃyutam ..
aśaktastu phalānyeva yathoktāni vidhānataḥ .. 19 ..
4.98.d:
इत्युच्चार्य च तत्सर्वमलंकृत्य विभूषणैः ॥
शक्तश्चेच्छयनं दद्यात्सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् ॥
अशक्तस्तु फलान्येव यथोक्तानि विधानतः ॥ 19 ॥
4.98.m: Having uttered this and adorned everything with ornaments, / if one is able, one should give a bed furnished with all accoutrements; / but if unable, only the fruits as prescribed according to the rule.

4.98.s:
tathodakuṃbhasahitau śivadharmau ca kāṃcanau ..
viprāya dattvā bhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam ..
anyānapi yathā śaktyā bhojayeddvijapuṅgavān .. 4.98.20 ..
4.98.d:
तथोदकुंभसहितौ शिवधर्मौ च कांचनौ ॥
विप्राय दत्त्वा भुञ्जीत तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥
अन्यानपि यथा शक्त्या भोजयेद्द्विजपुङ्गवान् ॥ 4.98.20 ॥
4.98.m: Likewise, having given to the brahmin two golden [images of] Śiva and Dharma accompanied by water-jars, / one should eat food free from oil and alkaline substances. / One should also feed other eminent twice-born men according to one's means.

4.98.s:
na śaknoti vihātuṃ cetsarvāṇyapi phalānyuta ..
ekameva parityajya taditthaṃ pratipādayet .. 21 ..
4.98.d:
न शक्नोति विहातुं चेत्सर्वाण्यपि फलान्युत ॥
एकमेव परित्यज्य तदित्थं प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.98.m: If one is unable to give up all fruits, / one should abandon even a single one and present it in this manner.

4.98.s:
etattyāgavratānāṃ tu gave vaiṣṇavayoginām ..
śastaṃ sarvaphalatyāgaṃ vrataṃ vedavido viduḥ ..
nārībhiśca yathāśaktyā kartavyaṃ rājasattama .. 22 ..
4.98.d:
एतत्त्यागव्रतानां तु गवे वैष्णवयोगिनाम् ॥
शस्तं सर्वफलत्यागं व्रतं वेदविदो विदुः ॥
नारीभिश्च यथाशक्त्या कर्तव्यं राजसत्तम ॥ 22 ॥
4.98.m: Among these observances of renunciation, the knowers of the Veda consider the observance / consisting of the renunciation of all fruits to be especially praised for Vaiṣṇava ascetics. / It should also be performed by women according to their means, O best of kings.

4.98.s:
naitasmādaparaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca ..
vratamasti muniśreṣṭha yadannaṃ tatphalapradam ..23..
4.98.d:
नैतस्मादपरं किञ्चिदिह लोके परत्र च ॥
व्रतमस्ति मुनिश्रेष्ठ यदन्नं तत्फलप्रदम् ॥23॥
4.98.m: There is no other observance than this, O best of sages, in this world or in the next; / whatever food one eats, it yields that very fruit.

4.98.s:
sauvarṇaraupyatāmreṣu yāvaṃtaḥ paramāṇavaḥ..
bhavaṃti cūryamāṇeṣu phaleṣu nṛpasattama ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate .. 24 ..
4.98.d:
सौवर्णरौप्यताम्रेषु यावंतः परमाणवः॥
भवंति चूर्यमाणेषु फलेषु नृपसत्तम ॥
तावद्युगसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥ 24 ॥
4.98.m: As many atoms as there are in these gold, silver, and copper / fruits when they are ground to powder, O best of kings, / for that many thousands of yugas one is glorified in Rudra's world.

4.98.s:
etatsamastakaluṣāpaharaṃ janānāmājīvanāya manujeśvara sarvadā syāt ..
janmāntareṣvapi na putrakalatraduḥkhamāpnoti dhāma sa puraṃdarajuṣṭameva .. 25 ..
4.98.d:
एतत्समस्तकलुषापहरं जनानामाजीवनाय मनुजेश्वर सर्वदा स्यात् ॥
जन्मान्तरेष्वपि न पुत्रकलत्रदुःखमाप्नोति धाम स पुरंदरजुष्टमेव ॥ 25 ॥
4.98.m: May this, which removes all impurities of people, always be for their sustenance, O lord of men! / Even in other births one does not experience the grief caused by sons or wives; one attains the very abode frequented by Purandara.

4.98.s:
yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣolpadhano naro vā yo brāhmaṇastu bhavaneṣu ca dhārmikāṇām..
pāpairvimuktaśca paratra puraṃ murārerānaṃdakṛtparamupaiti narendra sopi ..26.. ..
paurṇamāsīvratavarṇanam
4.98.d:
यो वा शृणोति पुरुषोल्पधनो नरो वा यो ब्राह्मणस्तु भवनेषु च धार्मिकाणाम्॥
पापैर्विमुक्तश्च परत्र पुरं मुरारेरानंदकृत्परमुपैति नरेन्द्र सोपि ॥26॥ ॥
पौर्णमासीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.98.m:
Whatever man listens to it, whether a person of small wealth or a brahmin in the houses of the righteous, / he too, freed from sins, goes in the next world to the supreme city of Murāri that causes delight, O king.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Full Moon Day

4.99.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
paurṇamāsī mahārāja somasya dayitā tithiḥ ..
pūrṇamāso bhavedyasyāṃ paurṇamāsī tataḥ smṛtā .. 1 ..
4.99.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पौर्णमासी महाराज सोमस्य दयिता तिथिः ॥
पूर्णमासो भवेद्यस्यां पौर्णमासी ततः स्मृता ॥ 1 ॥
4.99.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The full moon day, O great king, is the beloved lunar day of Soma. / Because the full month is completed on it, it is therefore traditionally called paurṇamāsī.

4.99.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃjātaḥ saṃgrāmo jayalakṣaṇaḥ ..
somasyāribudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram .. .. 2 ..
4.99.d:
पौर्णमास्यां च संजातः संग्रामो जयलक्षणः ॥
सोमस्यारिबुधैः सार्द्धं सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरम् ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
4.99.m: And on the full moon day there took place a battle marked by victory, / between Soma and his wise enemies, terrifying to all living beings.

4.99.s:
tārāyāṃ candramāḥ saktastasyā bhartā bṛhaspatiḥ ..
tayorabhūnmahāyuddhaṃ bhāryākṛtyeṣu vai purā .. 3 ..
4.99.d:
तारायां चन्द्रमाः सक्तस्तस्या भर्ता बृहस्पतिः ॥
तयोरभून्महायुद्धं भार्याकृत्येषु वै पुरा ॥ 3 ॥
4.99.m: The Moon was attached to Tārā; Bṛhaspati was her husband. / In ancient times a great war arose between the two of them concerning the duties toward a wife.

4.99.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
tārā kasya sutā kasmātsa kruddhaḥ sasurārihā ..
somena saha saṃgrāmaṃ cakre cakragadādhara .. 4 ..
4.99.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
तारा कस्य सुता कस्मात्स क्रुद्धः ससुरारिहा ॥
सोमेन सह संग्रामं चक्रे चक्रगदाधर ॥ 4 ॥
4.99.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Whose daughter was Tārā, and why did he, the slayer of the enemies of the gods, / become enraged and fight a battle with Soma, O wielder of the discus and mace?

4.99.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
prajāpaterabhūtkanyā tārā vṛtrasya cānujā ..
tāṃ bṛhaspataye prādātpṛthivyāmekasuṃdarīm .. 5 ..
4.99.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रजापतेरभूत्कन्या तारा वृत्रस्य चानुजा ॥
तां बृहस्पतये प्रादात्पृथिव्यामेकसुंदरीम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.99.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Tārā was the daughter of Prajāpati and the younger sister of Vṛtra. / He gave her, the singular beauty upon the earth, to Bṛhaspati.

4.99.s:
devācāryāya sā bhāryā tvanirdeśyā tathāvidhā ..
rūpeṇābhyāṃ rūpavatī sā nirdhūya vyavasthitā .. 6 ..
4.99.d:
देवाचार्याय सा भार्या त्वनिर्देश्या तथाविधा ॥
रूपेणाभ्यां रूपवती सा निर्धूय व्यवस्थिता ॥ 6 ॥
4.99.m: She, such a wife, was beyond description for the teacher of the gods; / surpassing all others in beauty, she stood pre-eminent with her lovely form.

4.99.s:
bṛhaspatiṃ paryacaradyathā cānyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit ..
tāṃ dadarśāyatāpāṃgīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ cāruhāsinīm .. 7 ..
4.99.d:
बृहस्पतिं पर्यचरद्यथा चान्याः स्त्रियः क्वचित् ॥
तां ददर्शायतापांगीं तन्वंगीं चारुहासिनीम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.99.m: She served Bṛhaspati just as other women do elsewhere. / The Cool-rayed [Moon] saw her, long-eyed, slender-limbed, and sweetly smiling;

4.99.s:
śītāṃśurdarśanādeva kāmasya vaśamīyivān ..
ābabhāṣe ca madhuraṃ tāre ehyehi mā ciram .. 8 ..
4.99.d:
शीतांशुर्दर्शनादेव कामस्य वशमीयिवान् ॥
आबभाषे च मधुरं तारे एह्येहि मा चिरम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.99.m: the moment he saw her, he fell under the sway of desire. / And he spoke sweetly: “O Tārā, come, come, do not delay!”

4.99.s:
iṃgitākārakuśalā tārā somasya ceṣṭitam ..
buddhvā śuddhimatho tanvī prāhedaṃ madhurākṣaram .. 9 ..
4.99.d:
इंगिताकारकुशला तारा सोमस्य चेष्टितम् ॥
बुद्ध्वा शुद्धिमथो तन्वी प्राहेदं मधुराक्षरम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.99.m: Skilled in reading gestures and facial expressions, the slender woman, / having perceived Soma's intention, then spoke these sweet words with purity of mind:

4.99.s:
muneraṃgirasaḥ putrastvaṃ ca saumyo'si somarāṭ ..
aṃgiraso munervīra snuṣāhamucitaṃ na te ..
saha saumyena yo yogastava siddho' dbhuto mahān .. 4.99.10 ..
4.99.d:
मुनेरंगिरसः पुत्रस्त्वं च सौम्योऽसि सोमराट् ॥
अंगिरसो मुनेर्वीर स्नुषाहमुचितं न ते ॥
सह सौम्येन यो योगस्तव सिद्धो' द्भुतो महान् ॥ 4.99.10 ॥
4.99.m: “You are the son of the sage Aṅgiras, and you are gentle, King Soma! / O hero, I am the daughter-in-law of the sage Aṅgiras; this is not proper for you. / What a great and wonderful union has been accomplished for you with the gentle one!

4.99.s:
aṃgirāstvāṃ kila purā sasurāsurarākṣasaiḥ ..
rājatve sthāpayāmāsa naitatsmarasi kiṃ vidho .. 11 ..
4.99.d:
अंगिरास्त्वां किल पुरा ससुरासुरराक्षसैः ॥
राजत्वे स्थापयामास नैतत्स्मरसि किं विधो ॥ 11 ॥
4.99.m: In ancient times, indeed, Aṅgiras established you in kingship / along with the gods, asuras, and rākṣasas; do you not remember this, O Moon?

4.99.s:
kathamadya niśānātha hyanaṃgenāsi pīḍitaḥ ..
tasmādbravīmi siddhiṃ te rocaye ghaṭitaṃ kuru ..
paravatyasmi bhadraṃ te na gamyāsmi budhottama .. 12 ..
4.99.d:
कथमद्य निशानाथ ह्यनंगेनासि पीडितः ॥
तस्माद्ब्रवीमि सिद्धिं ते रोचये घटितं कुरु ॥
परवत्यस्मि भद्रं ते न गम्यास्मि बुधोत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
4.99.m: How is it that today, O lord of the night, you are tormented by the bodiless one [Kāma]? / Therefore I speak for your welfare; do what is right according to my wish. / I am under another's authority, may you be blessed; I am not to be approached, O best of the wise!”

4.99.s:
evamuktastathā cāsau na caitatkṛtavāṃstataḥ ..
gṛhītvākarṣayāmāsa somo'naṃgavaśīkṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
4.99.d:
एवमुक्तस्तथा चासौ न चैतत्कृतवांस्ततः ॥
गृहीत्वाकर्षयामास सोमोऽनंगवशीकृतः ॥ 13 ॥
4.99.m: Though spoken to thus, he did not act accordingly. / Overcome by the bodiless one [Kāma], Soma seized her and pulled her away.

4.99.s:
bṛhaspatistu tāṃ jñātvā sa taṃ somamagarhayat ..
preṣayiṣyati me bhāryāṃ svayameva mamāṃtikam .. 14 ..
4.99.d:
बृहस्पतिस्तु तां ज्ञात्वा स तं सोममगर्हयत् ॥
प्रेषयिष्यति मे भार्यां स्वयमेव ममांतिकम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.99.m: Bṛhaspati, having learned of her [abduction], censured Soma, [thinking]: / “He will surely send my wife back to me of his own accord.”

4.99.s:
evaṃ cireṇa vijñāya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
nāsasāda svakāṃ bhāryāṃ roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ .. 15 ..
4.99.d:
एवं चिरेण विज्ञाय बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ॥
नाससाद स्वकां भार्यां रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः ॥ 15 ॥
4.99.m: Knowing thus after a long time, the noble-minded Bṛhaspati, / not recovering his own wife, had his lower lip trembling with rage.

4.99.s:
ācakhyau sarvamindrāya somasyedaṃ viceṣṭitam ..
iṃdraḥ samāhvayāmāsa devānṛṣigaṇāṃstathā .. 16 ..
4.99.d:
आचख्यौ सर्वमिन्द्राय सोमस्येदं विचेष्टितम् ॥
इंद्रः समाह्वयामास देवानृषिगणांस्तथा ॥ 16 ॥
4.99.m: He related all this conduct of Soma to Indra. / Indra summoned the gods and the hosts of sages.

4.99.s:
na somo gaṇayāmāsa tato'budhyata devarāṭ ..
ākāryaṃ tridaśānsarvānācakhyau candraceṣṭitam .. 17 ..
4.99.d:
न सोमो गणयामास ततोऽबुध्यत देवराट् ॥
आकार्यं त्रिदशान्सर्वानाचख्यौ चन्द्रचेष्टितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.99.m: Soma paid no heed; then the king of the gods understood. / Having summoned all the thirty [gods], he recounted the Moon's conduct.

4.99.s:
tacchrutvā devagaṃdharvāḥ krodhāndhāḥ kṣubdhamānasāḥ ..
pragṛhītapraharaṇā rathānāruruhuḥ svakān.. 18 ..
4.99.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवगंधर्वाः क्रोधान्धाः क्षुब्धमानसाः ॥
प्रगृहीतप्रहरणा रथानारुरुहुः स्वकान्॥ 18 ॥
4.99.m: Hearing that, the gods and gandharvas, blinded by anger and agitated in mind, / took up their weapons and mounted their chariots.

4.99.s:
somo'pi devānsodyogāñjñātvā sukṛtaniścayān ..
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi samānīya vyavasthitaḥ .. 19 ..
4.99.d:
सोमोऽपि देवान्सोद्योगाञ्ज्ञात्वा सुकृतनिश्चयान् ॥
दैत्यदानवरक्षांसि समानीय व्यवस्थितः ॥ 19 ॥
4.99.m: Soma too, knowing that the gods were prepared for action and firm in their resolve, / stood ready, having brought together the daityas, dānavas, and rakṣases.

4.99.s:
āruhya ca rathaśreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe ..
pravṛttaṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ śaratomarakaṃpanaiḥ .. 4.99.20 ..
4.99.d:
आरुह्य च रथश्रेष्ठं युद्धायैव मनो दधे ॥
प्रवृत्तं सुमहद्युद्धं शरतोमरकंपनैः ॥ 4.99.20 ॥
4.99.m: Mounting his excellent chariot, he set his mind on battle. / A tremendous war commenced with arrows, javelins, and shaking spears.

4.99.s:
kauṇapaiḥ kṣmāsuraiḥ śūlairdevadānavadāraṇam ..
sa teṣāṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ dattvā tārāgaṇādhipaḥ...
babhaṃja devānsendrāṃśca hemavṛṣṭyā kṣapākaraḥ .. 21 ..
4.99.d:
कौणपैः क्ष्मासुरैः शूलैर्देवदानवदारणम् ॥
स तेषां सुमहद्युद्धं दत्त्वा तारागणाधिपः॥।
बभंज देवान्सेन्द्रांश्च हेमवृष्ट्या क्षपाकरः ॥ 21 ॥
4.99.m: With spear-like missiles, earthen arrows, and tridents that tore apart gods and Dānavas. / Offering them tremendous battle, the lord of the stars, / the night-maker, broke the gods, along with Indra, with a shower of gold.

4.99.s:
sa jitvā devagandharvānsomo rājanyasattama ..
śriyā paramayā yukto yathā nānyo havirbhujām .. .. 22 ..
4.99.d:
स जित्वा देवगन्धर्वान्सोमो राजन्यसत्तम ॥
श्रिया परमया युक्तो यथा नान्यो हविर्भुजाम् ॥ ॥ 22 ॥
4.99.m: Having vanquished the gods and Gandharvas, O best of kings, / Soma was endowed with supreme splendor, as was no other among the consumers of oblations.

4.99.s:
devāśca nirjitāstena somenāmitatejasā ..
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svargavāsinām .. 23 ..
4.99.d:
देवाश्च निर्जितास्तेन सोमेनामिततेजसा ॥
आजग्मुः शरणं देवं शरण्यं स्वर्गवासिनाम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.99.m: And the gods, utterly defeated by that Soma of boundless brilliance, / went for refuge to the god who is the refuge of the dwellers in heaven.

4.99.s:
indraḥ sarvaṃ samācakhyau somasyedṛgviceṣṭitam ..
śrutvā kruddho hṛṣīkeśa āruhya garuḍaṃ ruṣā ..
gṛhītvā cāyudhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe .. 24 ..
4.99.d:
इन्द्रः सर्वं समाचख्यौ सोमस्येदृग्विचेष्टितम् ॥
श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो हृषीकेश आरुह्य गरुडं रुषा ॥
गृहीत्वा चायुधं श्रेष्ठं युद्धायैव मनो दधे ॥ 24 ॥
4.99.m: Indra recounted everything—such conduct of Soma. / Hearing it, Hṛṣīkeśa became angry; mounting Garuḍa in wrath / and taking up his supreme weapon, he set his mind on war.

4.99.s:
prakartuṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ cakraśārṅgagadā dharaḥ ..
jagāma vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ somasyopari roṣitaḥ .. 25 ..
4.99.d:
प्रकर्तुं सुमहद्युद्धं चक्रशार्ङ्गगदा धरः ॥
जगाम विबुधैः सार्धं सोमस्योपरि रोषितः ॥ 25 ॥
4.99.m: Bearing the discus, Śārṅga bow, and mace to wage a great battle, / he went, enraged, along with the gods, against Soma.

4.99.s:
viṣṇuṃ viditvā saṃprāptaṃ somo daityagaṇaiḥ saha ..
yuddhāya samarāmarṣī sthitaḥ pradhmāya vārijam .. 26 ..
4.99.d:
विष्णुं विदित्वा संप्राप्तं सोमो दैत्यगणैः सह ॥
युद्धाय समरामर्षी स्थितः प्रध्माय वारिजम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.99.m: Knowing Viṣṇu had arrived, Soma, along with the hosts of Daityas, / stood eager for the battle's rage, having blown his conch.

4.99.s:
sa jitvā devasaṃghātaṃ seṃdraṃ vāyupurassaram ..
viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ śastrāstrairasubhojanaiḥ .. 27 ..
4.99.d:
स जित्वा देवसंघातं सेंद्रं वायुपुरस्सरम् ॥
विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः शस्त्रास्त्रैरसुभोजनैः ॥ 27 ॥
4.99.m: Having defeated the assembly of gods headed by Vāyu and with Indra, / he engaged with Viṣṇu with weapons and missiles that devour life.

4.99.s:
yadā nāsāvuparamedyuddhāya saha viṣṇunā ..
tadā''dade ruṣā viṣṇuścakaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ .. 28 ..
4.99.d:
यदा नासावुपरमेद्युद्धाय सह विष्णुना ॥
तदा'ऽददे रुषा विष्णुश्चकं क्रोधसमन्वितः ॥ 28 ॥
4.99.m: When he would not desist from battling Viṣṇu, / then Viṣṇu in anger, filled with wrath, took up his discus.

4.99.s:
athāha brahmā deveśamajitaṃ viṣṇumavyayam ..
yo'sau meghaprapuṣṭāṃgaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi nibodha tat .. 29 ..
4.99.d:
अथाह ब्रह्मा देवेशमजितं विष्णुमव्ययम् ॥
योऽसौ मेघप्रपुष्टांगं यत्त्वां वच्मि निबोध तत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.99.m: Then Brahmā said to Viṣṇu, the imperishable, unconquered lord of the gods, / whose body is like a raincloud: 'Understand what I say to you:

4.99.s:
nāsti vadhyaṃ tribhuvane cakrasyāsya tavānagha ..
somo dvijādhipatye ca mayā samabhiṣecitaḥ .. 4.99.30 ..
4.99.d:
नास्ति वध्यं त्रिभुवने चक्रस्यास्य तवानघ ॥
सोमो द्विजाधिपत्ये च मया समभिषेचितः ॥ 4.99.30 ॥
4.99.m: There is nothing in the three worlds that cannot be slain by this discus of yours, O sinless one. / But Soma was consecrated by me to the sovereignty over the twice-born.

4.99.s:
tasmādyadyujyate devakārye'smiṃstadvidhīyatām ..
athāha bhagavānviṣṇuḥ surabrahmarṣisannidhau .. 31 ..
4.99.d:
तस्माद्यद्युज्यते देवकार्येऽस्मिंस्तद्विधीयताम् ॥
अथाह भगवान्विष्णुः सुरब्रह्मर्षिसन्निधौ ॥ 31 ॥
4.99.m: Therefore, do whatever is fitting in this matter of the gods.' / Then the blessed Lord Viṣṇu spoke in the presence of the gods and celestial sages:

4.99.s:
sinīvālī kuhūrnāma tasyāṃ naṣṭaḥ kṣapākaraḥ ..
vinaṣṭo'pi punarjanma prāpsyatīti na saṃśayaḥ .. 32 ..
4.99.d:
सिनीवाली कुहूर्नाम तस्यां नष्टः क्षपाकरः ॥
विनष्टोऽपि पुनर्जन्म प्राप्स्यतीति न संशयः ॥ 32 ॥
4.99.m: 'On Sinīvālī and Kuhū, the night-maker shall disappear. / Even when vanished, he shall obtain rebirth; of this there is no doubt.

4.99.s:
rākāṃ cānumatiṃ prāpya vṛddhirasya bhaviṣyati ..
āpyāyitaśca śrutyuktaiḥ pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtrakaiḥ ..
brāhmaṇairhavyakavyāni devebhyaḥ prāpayiṣyati .. 33..
4.99.d:
राकां चानुमतिं प्राप्य वृद्धिरस्य भविष्यति ॥
आप्यायितश्च श्रुत्युक्तैः पितृपिण्डैः समंत्रकैः ॥
ब्राह्मणैर्हव्यकव्यानि देवेभ्यः प्रापयिष्यति ॥ 33॥
4.99.m: And having reached Rākā and Anumati, he shall experience growth. / And nourished by ancestral balls of rice accompanied by mantras as stated in the Śruti, / through the brāhmaṇas he will deliver the offerings to gods and ancestors.

4.99.s:
vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇena caivāsya na ca jātasya bhūyasī ..
evameva vidhirdṛṣṭastasyāpyāya nameva me .. 34 ..
4.99.d:
वृद्धिः कृष्णेन चैवास्य न च जातस्य भूयसी ॥
एवमेव विधिर्दृष्टस्तस्याप्याय नमेव मे ॥ 34 ॥
4.99.m: And his increase shall come through the dark fortnight, yet not greater than when he was born; / thus has the rule been seen: his waxing indeed belongs to me.

4.99.s:
amoghasya na moghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati kadācana ..
śaptaśca somo dakṣeṇa sa cāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 35 ..
4.99.d:
अमोघस्य न मोघत्वं भविष्यति कदाचन ॥
शप्तश्च सोमो दक्षेण स चावश्यं भविष्यति ॥ 35 ॥
4.99.m: What is infallible can never become in vain. / Moreover, Soma was cursed by Dakṣa, and that [curse] must certainly come to pass.

4.99.s:
sudarśanasya ca prītirevameva bhaviṣyati ..
evamastviti deveśa yadbhavānprabravīti vai .. 36 ..
4.99.d:
सुदर्शनस्य च प्रीतिरेवमेव भविष्यति ॥
एवमस्त्विति देवेश यद्भवान्प्रब्रवीति वै ॥ 36 ॥
4.99.m: And thus will be the pleasure of Sudarśana.' / [Brahmā said:] 'Let it be so, O lord of gods, just as you say.'

4.99.s:
brahmā provāca somaṃ tu vinītavadupasthitam ..
arpayasva gurorbhāryāṃ na kāryaṃ punarīdṛśam .. 37 ..
4.99.d:
ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच सोमं तु विनीतवदुपस्थितम् ॥
अर्पयस्व गुरोर्भार्यां न कार्यं पुनरीदृशम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.99.m: Then Brahmā spoke to Soma, who stood humbly before him: / 'Surrender the guru's wife; such an act is not to be done again.'

4.99.s:
sa tathoktaḥ samānīya dadau tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ..
punarūce śaśī spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām ..38 ..
4.99.d:
स तथोक्तः समानीय ददौ तारां बृहस्पतेः ॥
पुनरूचे शशी स्पष्टं शृण्वतां त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥38 ॥
4.99.m: Being thus addressed, he brought Tārā and gave her to Bṛhaspati. / Again the moon spoke clearly, while the dwellers of heaven were listening:

4.99.s:
asyāṃ garbho madīyo'yaṃ yadapatyaṃ mamaiva tat ..
bṛhaspatirathovāca mayā garbhaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 39 ..
4.99.d:
अस्यां गर्भो मदीयोऽयं यदपत्यं ममैव तत् ॥
बृहस्पतिरथोवाच मया गर्भः समाहितः ॥ 39 ॥
4.99.m: 'This embryo in her is mine; whatever child it is, is mine alone.' / Bṛhaspati then said: 'The seed was placed by me;

4.99.s:
kṣetre madīye cotpannastasmātsa mama putrakaḥ..
uktaṃ ca vedaśāstrajñairṣibhirddharmadarśibhiḥ .. 4.99.40 ..
4.99.d:
क्षेत्रे मदीये चोत्पन्नस्तस्मात्स मम पुत्रकः॥
उक्तं च वेदशास्त्रज्ञैर्षिभिर्द्धर्मदर्शिभिः ॥ 4.99.40 ॥
4.99.m: and it was born in my field; therefore he is my son. / And it is declared by the sages who know the Vedas and treatises, who perceive dharma:

4.99.s:
uptaṃ vātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati ..
kṣetriṇastasya tadbījaṃ na bījī phalabhāgbhavet .. 41 ..
4.99.d:
उप्तं वाताहृतं बीजं यस्य क्षेत्रे प्ररोहति ॥
क्षेत्रिणस्तस्य तद्बीजं न बीजी फलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 41 ॥
4.99.m: "A seed sown or brought by the wind, which sprouts in someone's field, / belongs to the owner of the field; the owner of the seed shall not share in the fruit."'

4.99.s:
samyaguktaṃ na bhavatā śaśāṃkaḥ prāha tattvavit ..
mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ ..
iti paurāṇikāḥ prāhurmunayo nayacakṣuṣaḥ .. 42 ..
4.99.d:
सम्यगुक्तं न भवता शशांकः प्राह तत्त्ववित् ॥
माता भस्त्रा पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः ॥
इति पौराणिकाः प्राहुर्मुनयो नयचक्षुषः ॥ 42 ॥
4.99.m: 'That was not correctly spoken by you,' said the moon, knowing the truth. / 'The mother is a bellows; the son belongs to the father: he is the very one by whom he was begotten. / Thus have declared the knowers of the Purāṇas, the sages whose eyes are discernment.'

4.99.s:
vivadaṃtau nivāryātha brahmā provāca tāṃ vadhūm ..
śanairekāṃtamānīya garbhoyaṃ kasya śaṃsa me .. 43 ..
4.99.d:
विवदंतौ निवार्याथ ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तां वधूम् ॥
शनैरेकांतमानीय गर्भोयं कस्य शंस मे ॥ 43 ॥
4.99.m: Restraining the two who were disputing, Brahmā then said to that young woman, / having led her aside quietly: 'Tell me, whose embryo is this?'

4.99.s:
evamuktā tu sā tārā hriyā novāca kiṃcana ..
utsasarja kṣaṇādgarbhaṃ bhābhāsitasurālayam .. 44 ..
4.99.d:
एवमुक्ता तु सा तारा ह्रिया नोवाच किंचन ॥
उत्ससर्ज क्षणाद्गर्भं भाभासितसुरालयम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.99.m: Being thus addressed, Tārā said nothing out of shame; / in an instant she gave birth to the child, who illuminated the abode of the gods with his splendor.

4.99.s:
tamuvāca tato brahmā putra kasya suto bhavān ..
somasyāhaṃ suto brahmanniti tathyaṃ mayoditam .. .. 45 ..
4.99.d:
तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा पुत्र कस्य सुतो भवान् ॥
सोमस्याहं सुतो ब्रह्मन्निति तथ्यं मयोदितम् ॥ ॥ 45 ॥
4.99.m: Then Brahmā said to him: 'Child, whose son are you?' / [He replied:] 'O Brahmā, I am the son of Soma; this is the truth spoken by me.'

4.99.s:
budho'yaṃ vibudhāḥ prāhuḥ sarvajñānavidāṃ varaḥ ..
gṛhītvā putrakaṃ somo jagāma svaṃ niveśanam .. 46 ..
4.99.d:
बुधोऽयं विबुधाः प्राहुः सर्वज्ञानविदां वरः ॥
गृहीत्वा पुत्रकं सोमो जगाम स्वं निवेशनम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.99.m: 'He is Budha!' the gods proclaimed, 'foremost among knowers of all knowledge.' / Taking the child, Soma went to his own abode.

4.99.s:
gururgṛhītvā svāṃ bhāryāṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ śanaiḥ ..
somo'pi tanayaṃ labdhvā harṣavyākulamānasaḥ .. 47 ..
4.99.d:
गुरुर्गृहीत्वा स्वां भार्यां जगाम भवनं शनैः ॥
सोमोऽपि तनयं लब्ध्वा हर्षव्याकुलमानसः ॥ 47 ॥
4.99.m: The guru, taking his wife, went slowly to his residence. / Soma also, having obtained a son, had his mind overwhelmed with joy, [thinking:]

4.99.s:
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā prāptapūrṇamanorathā ..
prāptaḥ putro mayā hyasyāṃ labdhaśca vi jayastathā ..48..
4.99.d:
पौर्णमासी समाख्याता प्राप्तपूर्णमनोरथा ॥
प्राप्तः पुत्रो मया ह्यस्यां लब्धश्च वि जयस्तथा ॥48॥
4.99.m: '[This tithi] is called Paurṇamāsī, on which all desires are fulfilled! / For on it a son has been obtained by me, and victory has also been achieved.

4.99.s:
tasmādenāmupāsiṣye vidhinā vratatatparaḥ..
evamanyo'pi pūrṇārthaḥ pūrṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ..49..
4.99.d:
तस्मादेनामुपासिष्ये विधिना व्रततत्परः॥
एवमन्योऽपि पूर्णार्थः पूर्णांशः पूर्णलक्षणः ॥49॥
4.99.m: Therefore, devoted to vows, I will worship this [tithi] according to the injunctions. / Likewise, any other person whose purposes, parts, and marks are complete,

4.99.s:
yo māmakyāṃ tithau bhaktyā vidhivatpūjayiṣyati ..
tasya prasādābhimukhaḥ sarvakāmaprado hyaham .. 4.99.50 ..
4.99.d:
यो मामक्यां तिथौ भक्त्या विधिवत्पूजयिष्यति ॥
तस्य प्रसादाभिमुखः सर्वकामप्रदो ह्यहम् ॥ 4.99.50 ॥
4.99.m: who worships [me] according to rule with devotion on my tithi, / to him I shall be favorably disposed, bestowing all desires.'

4.99.s:
evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha somasya dayitā śubhā ..
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā pūrṇo māso bhavedyathā .. 51 ..
4.99.d:
एवमेषा तिथिः पार्थ सोमस्य दयिता शुभा ॥
पौर्णमासी समाख्याता पूर्णो मासो भवेद्यथा ॥ 51 ॥
4.99.m: Thus, O son of Pṛthā, this auspicious tithi is beloved of Soma; / it is called Paurṇamāsī, when the month becomes full.

4.99.s:
tadasyāṃ srotasi snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
ālikhya maṃḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum .. 52 ..
4.99.d:
तदस्यां स्रोतसि स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥
आलिख्य मंडले सोमं नक्षत्रैः सहितं विभुम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.99.m: Therefore, bathing in a stream on this day and propitiating the ancestors and gods, / drawing the lord Soma along with the lunar mansions in a mandala,

4.99.s:
pūjayetkusumairhṛdyairnaivedyairghṛtapācitaiḥ ..
śuklākṣataiḥ śuklavastraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet..
śākāharaṇamunyannairnaktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 53 ..
4.99.d:
पूजयेत्कुसुमैर्हृद्यैर्नैवेद्यैर्घृतपाचितैः ॥
शुक्लाक्षतैः शुक्लवस्त्रैः पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत्॥
शाकाहरणमुन्यन्नैर्नक्तं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥ 53 ॥
4.99.m: one should worship him with lovely flowers, food-offerings cooked in ghee, / white unhusked barley grains, and white garments, and after worshipping, beg forgiveness. / One should eat a nocturnal meal in silence, consisting of gathered greens or ascetics' food.

4.99.s:
vasaṃtabāṃdhava vidho śītāṃśo svasti naḥ kuru ..
gaganārṇavamāṇikya candra dākṣāyaṇīpate .. 54 ..
4.99.d:
वसंतबांधव विधो शीतांशो स्वस्ति नः कुरु ॥
गगनार्णवमाणिक्य चन्द्र दाक्षायणीपते ॥ 54 ॥
4.99.m: 'O friend of spring, O moon, O cold-rayed one, grant us well-being! / O ruby of the sky-ocean, O Candra, O husband of the daughters of Dakṣa!'

4.99.s:
pakṣepakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe'pi yaḥ kaścicchraddhāvānvai vratī bhavet .. 55..
4.99.d:
पक्षेपक्षे पौर्णमास्यां विधिरेष प्रकीर्तितः ॥
कृष्णपक्षेऽपि यः कश्चिच्छ्रद्धावान्वै व्रती भवेत् ॥ 55॥
4.99.m: Fortnight after fortnight on the full-moon day, this rite has been proclaimed. / If someone, full of faith, observes a votive observance on the dark fortnight as well,

4.99.s:
tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ..
āmāvāsyā tithiriyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dayitā sadā ..
asyāṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet .. 56 ..
4.99.d:
तस्याप्येष विधिः प्रोक्तः सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकः ॥
आमावास्या तिथिरियं पितॄणां दयिता सदा ॥
अस्यां दत्तं तपस्तप्तं पितॄणामक्षयं भवेत् ॥ 56 ॥
4.99.m: for him too this rite has been declared, granting all comforts. / This new-moon tithi is always dear to the ancestors; / what is given and the asceticism performed on it become imperishable for the ancestors.

4.99.s:
amāvāsyā mahārāja prayatnairyairupoṣitā ..
tairakṣayyaṃ bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastīrthamuttamam .. 57 ..
4.99.d:
अमावास्या महाराज प्रयत्नैर्यैरुपोषिता ॥
तैरक्षय्यं भवेद्दत्तं पितृभ्यस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.99.m: Those by whom the new-moon day is observed with fasting and diligence, O great king, / by them is given an imperishable, supreme sacred water to the ancestors.

4.99.s:
yaḥ kaścitkurute tasminpitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām ..
sa tārayati puṇyātmā puruṣānekaviṃśatim .. 58 ..
4.99.d:
यः कश्चित्कुरुते तस्मिन्पितृपिण्डोदकक्रियाम् ॥
स तारयति पुण्यात्मा पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.99.m: Whoever performs the rite of ancestral balls of rice and water on that day, / that virtuous soul delivers twenty-one generations [of his lineage].

4.99.s:
bhaveyurakṣayāstasya lokāḥ pitṛniṣevitāḥ ..
yadā tu iha kālāṃte tasyātrāgamanaṃ bhavet .. 59 ..
4.99.d:
भवेयुरक्षयास्तस्य लोकाः पितृनिषेविताः ॥
यदा तु इह कालांते तस्यात्रागमनं भवेत् ॥ 59 ॥
4.99.m: Imperishable worlds frequented by the ancestors shall be his. / When, at the end of time, his return here takes place,

4.99.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ..
evaṃ janmani rājendra bhaveddhanasamanvitaḥ .. 4.99.60 ..
4.99.d:
ब्राह्मणः पितृभक्तश्च सर्वविद्याविशारदः ॥
एवं जन्मनि राजेन्द्र भवेद्धनसमन्वितः ॥ 4.99.60 ॥
4.99.m: he will be born as a brāhmaṇa, devoted to his ancestors, skilled in all branches of learning, / and endowed with wealth, O ruler of kings.

4.99.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam ..
somaṃ nakṣatrasahitaṃ viprāya pratipādayet .. 61 ..
4.99.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते हैमं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् ॥
सोमं नक्षत्रसहितं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 61 ॥
4.99.m: Thus, at the end of a year, having fashioned a beautiful golden [image of] / Soma together with the lunar mansions, he should bestow it upon a brāhmaṇa.

4.99.s:
upadeśaṃ prayacchedyastasmai vratakṛte naraḥ ..
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairmaṃtreṇetthaṃ nivedayet ..
māsemāse vidhirayaṃ vratasyāsya narādhipa .. 62 ..
4.99.d:
उपदेशं प्रयच्छेद्यस्तस्मै व्रतकृते नरः ॥
संपूज्य वस्त्राभरणैर्मंत्रेणेत्थं निवेदयेत् ॥
मासेमासे विधिरयं व्रतस्यास्य नराधिप ॥ 62 ॥
4.99.m: The man who performs the votive observance should bestow instruction upon that [priest]; / having honoured him with garments and ornaments, he should present [the gift] with a mantra thus: / 'This is the procedure for this votive observance month after month, O ruler of men.'

4.99.s:
yo na śaknoti vā kartuṃ pakṣaṃ vātha niraṃtaram ..
sa ekāmapyupoṣyaiva kuryādudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ .. 63 ..
4.99.d:
यो न शक्नोति वा कर्तुं पक्षं वाथ निरंतरम् ॥
स एकामप्युपोष्यैव कुर्यादुद्यापनं सुधीः ॥ 63 ॥
4.99.m: Or whoever is unable to perform it continuously for a fortnight [or year], / that wise person, having fasted for even a single [lunar day], should perform the concluding rite.

4.99.s:
yaścaitatkurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaścandravaddivi rājate .. 64 ..
4.99.d:
यश्चैतत्कुरुते पार्थ पौर्णमासीव्रतं नरः ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तश्चन्द्रवद्दिवि राजते ॥ 64 ॥
4.99.m: And whatever man observes this full-moon votive observance, O Pārtha, / freed from all sins, shines in heaven like the moon.

4.99.s:
putrapautradhanopeto yajvā dātā priyaṃvadaḥ ..
saṃtatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhajet .. 65 ..
4.99.d:
पुत्रपौत्रधनोपेतो यज्वा दाता प्रियंवदः ॥
संततिं विपुलां प्राप्य प्रयागे मरणं भजेत् ॥ 65 ॥
4.99.m: Endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth, a sacrificer, generous, and speaking pleasantly, / having attained extensive progeny, he should meet his death at Prayāga.

4.99.s:
tataścaivākṣayām̐llokānprāpnoti surasevitān ..
sevyamānaḥ sa gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ..
āste saṃpūrṇasarvāṃgo yāvatkalpāyutatrayam .. 66 ..
4.99.d:
ततश्चैवाक्षयाम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरसेवितान् ॥
सेव्यमानः स गन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः ॥
आस्ते संपूर्णसर्वांगो यावत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् ॥ 66 ॥
4.99.m: And from there he attains the imperishable worlds attended by the gods; / attended by Gandharvas and praised by gods and Asuras, / he dwells with all his limbs perfected for thirty thousand kalpas.

4.99.s:
abhyarcayaṃti sitapañcadaśīṣu somaṃ kṛṣṇāsu ye pitṛgaṇaṃ jalapiṃḍadānaiḥ ..
teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi dhana dhānyasutādisaṃpatpūrṇāni pārthiva bhavaṃti vidhervidhānāt .. 67 ..
vaiśākhīkārttikīmāghīvratavarṇanam
4.99.d:
अभ्यर्चयंति सितपञ्चदशीषु सोमं कृष्णासु ये पितृगणं जलपिंडदानैः ॥
तेषां गृहाणि धन धान्यसुतादिसंपत्पूर्णानि पार्थिव भवंति विधेर्विधानात् ॥ 67 ॥
वैशाखीकार्त्तिकीमाघीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.99.m:
Those who worship the Moon on the bright fifteenth days, and the host of ancestors with offerings of water and rice-balls on the dark ones— / their houses, O king, become filled with wealth, grain, sons, and other fortunes, by destiny’s ordinance.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Full Moons of Vaiśākha, Kārttika, and Māgha

4.100.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃvatsare ca yāḥ kāścittithayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ ..
tā me vada yaduśreṣṭha snāne dāne mahāphalāḥ .. 1 ..
4.100.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
संवत्सरे च याः काश्चित्तिथयः पुण्यलक्षणाः ॥
ता मे वद यदुश्रेष्ठ स्नाने दाने महाफलाः ॥ 1 ॥
4.100.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'And whatever lunar days throughout the year possess auspicious marks / and yield great fruits through bathing and giving, tell them to me, O best of the Yadus.'

4.100.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayo'tīva pūjitāḥ ..
snānadānavihīnaistā na neyāḥ pāṃḍunandana .. 2 ..
4.100.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
वैशाखी कार्तिकी माघी तिथयोऽतीव पूजिताः ॥
स्नानदानविहीनैस्ता न नेयाः पांडुनन्दन ॥ 2 ॥
4.100.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'The lunar days of Vaiśākhī, Kārtikī, and Māghī are exceedingly revered; / they should not be spent without bathing and giving, O son of Pāṇḍu.

4.100.s:
tīrthasnānaṃ tadā śastaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ..
vaiśākhyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā dyotanikā matā .. 3 ..
4.100.d:
तीर्थस्नानं तदा शस्तं दानं वित्तानुरूपतः ॥
वैशाख्यां पांडवश्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठा द्योतनिका मता ॥ 3 ॥
4.100.m: Bathing at a sacred ford is praised at that time, and giving according to one’s wealth; / on Vaiśākhī, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, the Dyotanikā [river] is considered supreme.

4.100.s:
kārttikyāṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ māghyāṃ vārāṇasī smṛtā ..
snānenodakadānena tārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn ..4..
4.100.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां पुष्करारण्यं माघ्यां वाराणसी स्मृता ॥
स्नानेनोदकदानेन तारयत्यपि दुष्कृतीन् ॥4॥
4.100.m: On Kārttikī, the forest of Puṣkara is remembered [as best], and on Māghī, Vārāṇasī; / by bathing and giving water, one delivers even evil-doers.

4.100.s:
kuṃbhānsvachāṃbhasaḥ pūrṇānsahiraṇyānnasaṃyutān..
vaiśākhyāṃ brāhmaṇo dattvā na śocati kṛte vrate .. 5 ..
4.100.d:
कुंभान्स्वछांभसः पूर्णान्सहिरण्यान्नसंयुतान्॥
वैशाख्यां ब्राह्मणो दत्त्वा न शोचति कृते व्रते ॥ 5 ॥
4.100.m: Pots filled with clear water, along with gold and food— / having given these on Vaiśākhī, a Brahmin does not grieve when the votive observance is performed.

4.100.s:
madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇānbhājanānkanakojjvalān ..
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi vidhivatpratipādayet .. .. 6 ..
4.100.d:
मधुरान्नरसैः पूर्णान्भाजनान्कनकोज्ज्वलान् ॥
गोभूहिरण्यवासांसि विधिवत्प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
4.100.m: Vessels gleaming with gold, filled with sweet dishes and broths, / cows, land, gold, and garments should be presented according to the rule.

4.100.s:
māghyāṃ maghāsu ca tathā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
tilapātrāṇi deyāni tilāṃśca palalaudanam .. 7 ..
4.100.d:
माघ्यां मघासु च तथा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥
तिलपात्राणि देयानि तिलांश्च पललौदनम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.100.m: On Māghī and when the moon is in Maghā, having likewise gratified the ancestors and deities, / vessels filled with sesame, sesame seeds, and rice cooked with meat should be given.

4.100.s:
kārpāsadānamatraiva tiladānaṃ ca śasyate ..
kaṃbalājinaratnāni mocakau pāpamocakau ..8..
4.100.d:
कार्पासदानमत्रैव तिलदानं च शस्यते ॥
कंबलाजिनरत्नानि मोचकौ पापमोचकौ ॥8॥
4.100.m: Right here, the gift of cotton and the gift of sesame are praised; / blankets, deer hides, and jewels are liberators, liberators from sin.

4.100.s:
upānaddānamatraiva kathitaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
yatra vā tatra vā snānaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ..9..
4.100.d:
उपानद्दानमत्रैव कथितं सर्वकामदम् ॥
यत्र वा तत्र वा स्नानं दानं वित्तानुरूपतः ॥9॥
4.100.m: The gift of sandals right here is declared to bestow all desires; / bathing anywhere and giving according to one's wealth,

4.100.s:
kalikālodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śasyate pāṃḍunandana ..
kārtikyāṃ tu vṛṣotsargo vivāhaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇaḥ ..
kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha harernīrājanaṃ tathā .. 4.100.10 ..
4.100.d:
कलिकालोद्भवं सर्वं शस्यते पांडुनन्दन ॥
कार्तिक्यां तु वृषोत्सर्गो विवाहः पुण्यलक्षणः ॥
कार्यं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ हरेर्नीराजनं तथा ॥ 4.100.10 ॥
4.100.m: [and whatever is given in charity] arising in the Kali age, all is praised, O son of Pāṇḍu. / But on Kārtikī, the dedication of a bull, an auspicious marriage, / and the wave-offering of lamps to Hari should be performed, O best of Kuru's line.

4.100.s:
gajāśvarathadānaṃ ca ghṛtadhenvādayastathā ..
pradeyāḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca tāstāḥ saṃkalpya devatāḥ .. 11 ..
4.100.d:
गजाश्वरथदानं च घृतधेन्वादयस्तथा ॥
प्रदेयाः पुण्यकृद्भिश्च तास्ताः संकल्प्य देवताः ॥ 11 ॥
4.100.m: The gift of elephants, horses, and chariots, and ghee cows and the like, / should be presented by the doers of merit, having consecrated them to those various deities.

4.100.s:
phalāni yāni vidyaṃte sugandhimadhurāṇi ca ..
jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ lavaṃgaṃ lavalīphalam .. 12 ..
4.100.d:
फलानि यानि विद्यंते सुगन्धिमधुराणि च ॥
जातीफलं च कंकोलं लवंगं लवलीफलम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.100.m: Whatever fruits are available that are fragrant and sweet— / nutmeg, kankola, clove, and lavalī fruit,

4.100.s:
kharjūrīṃ nālikerāṃśca kadalyāśca phalāni ca ..
dāḍimānmātuluṃgāṃśca karkoṭāṃstrapusāṃstathā .. .. 13 ..
4.100.d:
खर्जूरीं नालिकेरांश्च कदल्याश्च फलानि च ॥
दाडिमान्मातुलुंगांश्च कर्कोटांस्त्रपुसांस्तथा ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
4.100.m: dates, coconuts, and banana fruits, / pomegranates, citrons, spiny gourds, and cucumbers,

4.100.s:
vṛṃtākānkāravellāṃśca biṃbānkūṣmāṃḍakarburān ..
apradānena yeṣāṃ tu tithayo yāṃti bhārata ..
te vyādhitā daridrāśca jāyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ .. .. 14 ..
4.100.d:
वृंताकान्कारवेल्लांश्च बिंबान्कूष्मांडकर्बुरान् ॥
अप्रदानेन येषां तु तिथयो यांति भारत ॥
ते व्याधिता दरिद्राश्च जायंते भुवि मानवाः ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
4.100.m: eggplants, bitter gourds, bimba fruits, and speckled ash-gourds— / men through whose non-giving of these the lunar days pass by, O Bhārata, / are born diseased and poor on earth.

4.100.s:
na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dānaṃ sarvasya śasyate ..
bhaginībhāgineyānāṃ mātulānāṃ pitṛṣvasuḥ ..
daridrāṇāṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ dānaṃ koṭiguṇotta ram .. 15 ..
4.100.d:
न केवलं ब्राह्मणानां दानं सर्वस्य शस्यते ॥
भगिनीभागिनेयानां मातुलानां पितृष्वसुः ॥
दरिद्राणां च बंधूनां दानं कोटिगुणोत्त रम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.100.m: Giving is not praised only for Brahmins; / a gift given to sisters, nephews, maternal uncles, paternal aunts, / and destitute kin is a crore times superior.

4.100.s:
mitraṃ kulīnaścāpanno vadhurdāridryaduḥkhitaḥ ..
āśayābhyāgato dūrātsotithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ ..16..
4.100.d:
मित्रं कुलीनश्चापन्नो वधुर्दारिद्र्यदुःखितः ॥
आशयाभ्यागतो दूरात्सोतिथिः स्वर्गसंक्रमः ॥16॥
4.100.m: A friend, a high-born person in distress, a bride afflicted with poverty, / who has arrived from afar with hope—such a guest is a bridge to heaven.

4.100.s:
vanaṃ prasthāpite rāme sasīte saha lakṣmaṇe ..
mātāmahakulādetya viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā ..
sā sarveḥ śrāvitānekaiḥ kośalyā bharatena vai .. 17 ..
4.100.d:
वनं प्रस्थापिते रामे ससीते सह लक्ष्मणे ॥
मातामहकुलादेत्य विशुद्धेनांतरात्मना ॥
सा सर्वेः श्रावितानेकैः कोशल्या भरतेन वै ॥ 17 ॥
4.100.m: When Rāma had been sent to the forest together with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa, / having returned from the house of his maternal grandfather, with a pure inner soul, / Kauśalyā was made to hear many [oaths] by Bharata.

4.100.s:
yadā na pratyayaṃ yāti kathaṃcitkośalātmajā ..
tadā viśuddhabhāvena tithayaḥ śrāvitāḥ punaḥ .. 18 ..
4.100.d:
यदा न प्रत्ययं याति कथंचित्कोशलात्मजा ॥
तदा विशुद्धभावेन तिथयः श्राविताः पुनः ॥ 18 ॥
4.100.m: When the daughter of the King of Kośala would not believe in any way, / then, with pure intent, the lunar days were once more sworn [by him]:

4.100.s:
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayomarapūjitāḥ ..
apradānavato yāṃti yasyāryyonumate gataḥ .. 19 ..
4.100.d:
वैशाखी कार्तिकी माघी तिथयोमरपूजिताः ॥
अप्रदानवतो यांति यस्यार्य्योनुमते गतः ॥ 19 ॥
4.100.m: 'May the lunar days of Vaiśākhī, Kārtikī, and Māghī, revered by the immortals, / pass without fruit for him with whose consent the noble one went [into exile]!'

4.100.s:
etacchrutvā tu kauśalyā sahasā pratyayaṃ gatā ..
aṃkamānīya bharataṃ sāṃtvayāmāsa duḥkhitam .. 4.100.20 ..
4.100.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौशल्या सहसा प्रत्ययं गता ॥
अंकमानीय भरतं सांत्वयामास दुःखितम् ॥ 4.100.20 ॥
4.100.m: Having heard this, Kauśalyā immediately came to believe; / taking Bharata onto her lap, she comforted the grieving [prince].

4.100.s:
etattithīnāṃ māhātmyamākhyātaṃ bahuvistaram ..
bhūyastu kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tava rājanmahāmate .. 21 ..
4.100.d:
एतत्तिथीनां माहात्म्यमाख्यातं बहुविस्तरम् ॥
भूयस्तु किं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव राजन्महामते ॥ 21 ॥
4.100.m: This greatness of the lunar days has been recounted in great detail; / what more shall I tell you, O king of great intellect?

4.100.s:
vaiśākhakārtikamaghāsahitātha māghe yā pūrṇimā bhavati pūrṇaśaśāṃkacihnā ..
tasyāṃ jalānnakanakāṃbaramātapatraṃ dattvā prayāti puruṣaḥ puruhūtalokam .. 22 .. ..
yugāditithivratamāhātmyavarṇanam
4.100.d:
वैशाखकार्तिकमघासहिताथ माघे या पूर्णिमा भवति पूर्णशशांकचिह्ना ॥
तस्यां जलान्नकनकांबरमातपत्रं दत्त्वा प्रयाति पुरुषः पुरुहूतलोकम् ॥ 22 ॥ ॥
युगादितिथिव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
4.100.m:
On that full moon in the month of Māgha which is accompanied by the asterism Maghā, and which is marked by a full moon, / a man who gives water, food, gold, clothing, and an umbrella goes to the world of Puruhūta.
Description of the Greatness of the Votive Observance on the Yugādi Lunar Days

4.101.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
punarme brūhi deveśa tvadbhaktyā bhāvitātmanaḥ ..
kathyamānamihecchāmi śubhadharmapadaṃ mahat .. 1 ..
4.101.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
पुनर्मे ब्रूहि देवेश त्वद्भक्त्या भावितात्मनः ॥
कथ्यमानमिहेच्छामि शुभधर्मपदं महत् ॥ 1 ॥
4.101.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Tell me again, O Lord of the gods, whose mind is steeped in devotion to you; / I wish to have narrated here the great, auspicious station of dharma,

4.101.s: yatrāṇvapi narairddattaṃ japtaṃ vā sumahadbhavet .. 2 .. ...
4.101.d: यत्राण्वपि नरैर्द्दत्तं जप्तं वा सुमहद्भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥ ॥।
4.101.m: wherein even an atom given or muttered by men becomes exceedingly great.'

4.101.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pāṃḍava te vacmi rahasyaṃ devanirmitam..
yanmayā kasyacinnoktaṃ supriyasyāpi bhārata .. 3 ..
4.101.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पांडव ते वच्मि रहस्यं देवनिर्मितम्॥
यन्मया कस्यचिन्नोक्तं सुप्रियस्यापि भारत ॥ 3 ॥
4.101.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Listen, O son of Pāṇḍu, I shall tell you a secret fashioned by the gods, / which has not been spoken by me to anyone, even one most dear, O Bhārata.

4.101.s:
vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā navamyasau kārtikaśuklapakṣe..
nabhasya māsasya tu kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīṃ pañcadaśīṃ ca māghe ..4..
4.101.d:
वैशाखमासस्य तु या तृतीया नवम्यसौ कार्तिकशुक्लपक्षे॥
नभस्य मासस्य तु कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदशीं पञ्चदशीं च माघे ॥4॥
4.101.m: The third [tithi] of the month of Vaiśākha, and that ninth in the bright fortnight of Kārtika, / the thirteenth in the dark fortnight of the month of Nabhasya, and the fifteenth in Māgha—

4.101.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā tu samā kṛtayutena tu..
navamī kārtike yā tu tretāyugasamāgatā .. 5 ..
4.101.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीया तु समा कृतयुतेन तु॥
नवमी कार्तिके या तु त्रेतायुगसमागता ॥ 5 ॥
4.101.m: the third of Vaiśākha is equal to the Kṛta age; / the ninth which falls in Kārtika is concurrent with the Tretā age;

4.101.s:
trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samāgatā ..
māghe pañcadaśī rājankalikālādirucyate.. 6 ..
4.101.d:
त्रयोदशी नभस्ये तु द्वापरेण समागता ॥
माघे पञ्चदशी राजन्कलिकालादिरुच्यते॥ 6 ॥
4.101.m: the thirteenth in Nabhasya is concurrent with the Dvāpara age; / and the fifteenth in Māgha, O king, is called the beginning of the Kali age.

4.101.s:
etāścatasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavādyathā ..
yugādayaśca kathyaṃte tathaitā sarvasūribhiḥ .. 7 ..
4.101.d:
एताश्चतस्रो राजेन्द्र युगानां प्रभवाद्यथा ॥
युगादयश्च कथ्यंते तथैता सर्वसूरिभिः ॥ 7 ॥
4.101.m: Because of the origination of the ages from these, O ruler of kings, / these four are declared by all wise men to be the Yugādis.

4.101.s:
upavāsastapo dānaṃ japahomakriyāstathā ..
yadyattu kriyate kiṃcitsarvaṃkoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
4.101.d:
उपवासस्तपो दानं जपहोमक्रियास्तथा ॥
यद्यत्तु क्रियते किंचित्सर्वंकोटिगुणं भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.101.m: Fasting, austerity, giving, and the rites of recitation and burnt-offering— / whatever little is done becomes multiplied ten-million-fold.'

4.101.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīsametaṃ jagadgurum ..
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayethāḥ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
vastrālaṃkārasaṃbhārainaivedyai rvividhaistathā .. 9 ..
4.101.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां श्रीसमेतं जगद्गुरुम् ॥
नारायणं पूजयेथाः पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ॥
वस्त्रालंकारसंभारैनैवेद्यै र्विविधैस्तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.101.m: On the third lunar day of Vaiśākha, you should worship Nārāyaṇa, the teacher of the universe, together with Śrī, / with flowers, incense, ointments, / with collections of garments and ornaments, and likewise with various kinds of food-offerings.

4.101.s:
tatastasyāgrato dhenurlavaṇasyāḍhakena tu ..
kāryā kurukulaśreṣṭha caturbhāgeṇa vatsakaḥ .. 4.101.10 ..
4.101.d:
ततस्तस्याग्रतो धेनुर्लवणस्याढकेन तु ॥
कार्या कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ चतुर्भागेण वत्सकः ॥ 4.101.10 ॥
4.101.m: Then, in front of him, O best of the Kuru lineage, a cow is to be made with an āḍhaka measure of salt, / and a calf with a fourth part [of that measure].

4.101.s:
avicarmopari sthāpya kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
śāstroktakramayogena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 11 ..
4.101.d:
अविचर्मोपरि स्थाप्य कल्पयित्वा विधानतः ॥
शास्त्रोक्तक्रमयोगेन ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.101.m: Having placed it upon a sheepskin and fashioned it according to the prescribed rules, / one should present it to a brāhmaṇa according to the procedure taught in the scriptures,

4.101.s:
śrīdharaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñchrīśaḥ saṃprīyatāmiti ..
anena vidhinā dattvā dhenuṃ viprāya bhārata ..
gosahasraṃ daśaguṇaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 12 ..
4.101.d:
श्रीधरः श्रीपतिः श्रीमाञ्छ्रीशः संप्रीयतामिति ॥
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा धेनुं विप्राय भारत ॥
गोसहस्रं दशगुणं प्राप्नोतीह न संशयः ॥ 12 ॥
4.101.m: saying: “May Śrīdhara, the lord of Śrī, the glorious lord of Śrī, be pleased.” / Having given the cow to a vipra according to this rite, O Bhārata, / one obtains tenfold [the merit of] a thousand cows in this world; of this there is no doubt.

4.101.s:
tathaiva kārtike māsi navamyāṃ naktabhuṅnaraḥ ..
snātvā nadītaḍāgeṣu devakhāteṣu vā punaḥ .. 13 ..
4.101.d:
तथैव कार्तिके मासि नवम्यां नक्तभुङ्नरः ॥
स्नात्वा नदीतडागेषु देवखातेषु वा पुनः ॥ 13 ॥
4.101.m: In the same manner, in the month of Kārtika, on the ninth lunar day, a man eating a nocturnal meal, / having bathed in rivers, ponds, or divine reservoirs,

4.101.s:
umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ nīlakaṃṭhamathārcayet ..
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyairaniṃdyaiḥ śaṃkaraṃ śivam .. 14 ..
4.101.d:
उमासहायं वरदं नीलकंठमथार्चयेत् ॥
पुष्पधूपादिनैवेद्यैरनिंद्यैः शंकरं शिवम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.101.m: should then worship the blue-throated, boon-giving Śiva, Śaṅkara, / accompanied by Umā, with irreproachable flowers, incense, food-offerings, and other [oblations].

4.101.s:
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyātpurāṇo ktavidhānataḥ ..
aṣṭamūrtirnīlakaṃṭhaḥ prīyatāmiti ciṃtayet .. 15 ..
4.101.d:
धेनुं तिलमयीं दद्यात्पुराणो क्तविधानतः ॥
अष्टमूर्तिर्नीलकंठः प्रीयतामिति चिंतयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.101.m: He should give a cow made of sesame according to the procedure stated in the Purāṇas, / and reflect: “May the eight-formed, blue-throated one be pleased.”

4.101.s:
yadatra prāpyate puṇyaṃ pārtha tatkena varṇyate ..
dattvā tilamayīṃ dhenuṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt .. 16 ..
4.101.d:
यदत्र प्राप्यते पुण्यं पार्थ तत्केन वर्ण्यते ॥
दत्त्वा तिलमयीं धेनुं शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 16 ॥
4.101.m: What religious merit is obtained here, O Pārtha, by whom could that be described? / Having given a cow made of sesame, one attains the world of Śiva.

4.101.s:
trayodaśī nabhasi yā kṛṣṇamasyāṃ samarcayet ..
pitṝnpāyasadānena madhunā ca ghṛtena tu ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā vedavedāṅgapāragān. 17 ..
4.101.d:
त्रयोदशी नभसि या कृष्णमस्यां समर्चयेत् ॥
पितॄन्पायसदानेन मधुना च घृतेन तु ॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान्। 17 ॥
4.101.m: The thirteenth lunar day of the dark fortnight which falls in Nabhas—on that [tithi] one should worship / the ancestors with a gift of milk-rice, honey, and ghee, / and feed with devotion brāhmaṇas who have crossed to the further shore of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences.

4.101.s:
pitṝnuddiśya dātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanī ..
pratyakṣā gaurmahārāja taruṇī supayasvinī .. 18 ..
4.101.d:
पितॄनुद्दिश्य दातव्या सवत्सा कांस्यदोहनी ॥
प्रत्यक्षा गौर्महाराज तरुणी सुपयस्विनी ॥ 18 ॥
4.101.m: Dedicated to the ancestors, there should be given [a cow] with its calf and a bronze milking pail, / an actual cow, O great king, young and yielding abundant milk.

4.101.s:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ..
prīyatāṃ gopradānena iti dattvā visarjayet .. 19 ..
4.101.d:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः ॥
प्रीयतां गोप्रदानेन इति दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.101.m: Saying: “May the father, the paternal grandfather, and likewise the paternal great-grandfather / be pleased by the gift of the cow,” one should give it and dismiss [the brāhmaṇa].

4.101.s:
kṛtenānena rājendra yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ ..
tatkena varṇituṃ yāti varṣakoṭiśatairapi .. 4.101.20 ..
4.101.d:
कृतेनानेन राजेन्द्र यत्पुण्यं प्राप्यते नृभिः ॥
तत्केन वर्णितुं याति वर्षकोटिशतैरपि ॥ 4.101.20 ॥
4.101.m: When this is performed, O best of kings, what religious merit is attained by men— / by whom can that be described even in hundreds of millions of years?

4.101.s:
putrānpautrānprapautrāṃśca dhanaṃ ca mahadīpsitam ..
iha cāpnoti puruṣaḥ paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim .. 21 ..
4.101.d:
पुत्रान्पौत्रान्प्रपौत्रांश्च धनं च महदीप्सितम् ॥
इह चाप्नोति पुरुषः परत्र च शुभां गतिम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.101.m: Sons, grandsons, great-grandsons, and great, desired wealth / a man attains in this world, and an auspicious state in the hereafter.

4.101.s:
pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya pūjayitvā pitāmaham ..
gāyatryā sahitaṃ devaṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitam .. 22 ..
4.101.d:
पञ्चदश्यां च माघस्य पूजयित्वा पितामहम् ॥
गायत्र्या सहितं देवं वेदवेदाङ्गभूषितम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.101.m: And on the fifteenth lunar day of Māgha, having worshipped the Grandfather [Brahmā], / the god accompanied by Gāyatrī, adorned with the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

4.101.s:
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ phalairnānāvidhairyutām ..
sahiraṇyāṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
kīrtayetprīyatāmatra padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ ..23..
4.101.d:
नवनीतमयीं धेनुं फलैर्नानाविधैर्युताम् ॥
सहिरण्यां सवत्सां च ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
कीर्तयेत्प्रीयतामत्र पद्मयोनिः पितामहः ॥23॥
4.101.m: one should present to a brāhmaṇa a cow made of fresh butter, accompanied by various kinds of fruits, / accompanied by gold and accompanied by a calf, / and should proclaim: “May the lotus-born Grandfather be pleased here.”

4.101.s:
yatsvarge yacca pātāle yacca martye sudurlabham ..
tadavāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ padmayoni prasādataḥ .. 24 ..
4.101.d:
यत्स्वर्गे यच्च पाताले यच्च मर्त्ये सुदुर्लभम् ॥
तदवाप्नोत्यसंदिग्धं पद्मयोनि प्रसादतः ॥ 24 ॥
4.101.m: Whatever is exceedingly rare in heaven, in the netherworld, or among mortals, / all that he undoubtedly attains through the grace of the lotus-born one.

4.101.s:
yāni cānyāni dānāni dattāni subahūnyapi ..
yugādiṣu mahārāja akṣayāni bhavaṃti hi .. 25 ..
4.101.d:
यानि चान्यानि दानानि दत्तानि सुबहून्यपि ॥
युगादिषु महाराज अक्षयानि भवंति हि ॥ 25 ॥
4.101.m: And whatever other gifts are given, even if very numerous, / on the yugādis, O great king, indeed become imperishable.

4.101.s:
alpamalpaṃ hi yaḥ kaścitpradadyānnirddhanopi san ..
tadakṣayaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ yugādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ .. 26 ..
4.101.d:
अल्पमल्पं हि यः कश्चित्प्रदद्यान्निर्द्धनोपि सन् ॥
तदक्षयं भवेत्सर्वं युगादिषु न संशयः ॥ 26 ॥
4.101.m: Even if poor, whatever little a person gives, / all of that becomes imperishable on the yugādis; of this there is no doubt.

4.101.s:
vittānusāraṃ svaṃ jñātvā vittavānpārthivopi vā ..
anusāreṇa vittasya asādhyena samādhinā .. 27 ..
4.101.d:
वित्तानुसारं स्वं ज्ञात्वा वित्तवान्पार्थिवोपि वा ॥
अनुसारेण वित्तस्य असाध्येन समाधिना ॥ 27 ॥
4.101.m: Knowing one's own means, whether wealthy or a king, / in accordance with one's wealth, with unsurpassable concentration,

4.101.s:
bhūrhiraṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ vāsaḥ śayanānyāsanāni ca ..
chatropānatsuyugmāni pradeyāni dvijātiṣu .. 28 ..
4.101.d:
भूर्हिरण्यं गृहं वासः शयनान्यासनानि च ॥
छत्रोपानत्सुयुग्मानि प्रदेयानि द्विजातिषु ॥ 28 ॥
4.101.m: land, gold, a house, clothing, beds and seats, / and pairs of umbrellas and shoes should be given to twice-born men.

4.101.s:
evaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijānapi ..
paścādbhuñjīta sumanā vāgyataḥ svajanaiḥ saha .. 29 ..
4.101.d:
एवं दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्या भोजयित्वा द्विजानपि ॥
पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत सुमना वाग्यतः स्वजनैः सह ॥ 29 ॥
4.101.m: Having given thus according to one's capacity, and having fed the twice-born men, / one should eat afterwards with one's kin, cheerful of mind and restraining one's speech.

4.101.s:
yatkiñcinmānasaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ tathā ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti yugāditithipūjanāt .. 4.101.30 ..
4.101.d:
यत्किञ्चिन्मानसं पापं कायिकं वाचिकं तथा ॥
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति युगादितिथिपूजनात् ॥ 4.101.30 ॥
4.101.m: Whatever sin of mind, body, or speech exists, / all that goes to destruction through the worship on the yugādi tithis.

4.101.s:
udgīyamāno gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ..
ramate cākṣayaṃ kālaṃ svargaloke na saṃśayaḥ ..31..
4.101.d:
उद्गीयमानो गन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः ॥
रमते चाक्षयं कालं स्वर्गलोके न संशयः ॥31॥
4.101.m: Lauded by Gandharvas and praised by gods and asuras, / he rejoices for an imperishable time in the heavenly world; of this there is no doubt.

4.101.s:
yaddīyate kimapi koṭiguṇaṃ tadāhuḥ snānaṃ japoniyamamakṣayameva sarvam ..
syādakṣayāsu yugapūrvatithīṣu rājanvyāsādayo munivarāḥ samudāharaṃti..32..
vaṭasāvitrīvratavarṇanam
4.101.d:
यद्दीयते किमपि कोटिगुणं तदाहुः स्नानं जपोनियममक्षयमेव सर्वम् ॥
स्यादक्षयासु युगपूर्वतिथीषु राजन्व्यासादयो मुनिवराः समुदाहरंति॥32॥
वटसावित्रीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.101.m:
Whatever is given, they say that is magnified ten-millionfold; bathing, recitation, and religious restraint are all imperishable. / On the imperishable tithis beginning the yugas, O king, excellent sages such as Vyāsa declare [this].
Description of the Vaṭasāvitrī Vrata.
